extends Node

var active_modules: Array = []
var total_power: float = 100.0
var current_power_draw: float = 0.0
var reactor_energy: float = 100.0
var oxygen_level: float = 100.0
var temp_level: float = 100.0

var failure_roll_interval: float = 6.0
var failure_chance: float = 0.18
var _failure_timer: float = 0.0

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if get_node_or_null("/root/GameManager") != null:
		if GameManager.current_phase != GameManager.Phase.SURVIVE:
			return

	_tick_power_and_systems(delta)
	_tick_failure_dice(delta)

func calculate_power() -> void:
	for i in range(active_modules.size() - 1, -1, -1):
		if not is_instance_valid(active_modules[i]):
			active_modules.remove_at(i)

	current_power_draw = 0.0
	total_power = 0.0

	for mod in active_modules:
		if mod.module_name == "Reactor" and not mod.is_broken and reactor_energy > 0.0:
			total_power += 100.0

	for mod in active_modules:
		if mod.module_name == "Reactor":
			mod.is_powered = reactor_energy > 0.0
			continue

		if mod.has_valid_power_source() and (current_power_draw + mod.power_draw <= total_power):
			mod.is_powered = true
			current_power_draw += mod.power_draw
		else:
			mod.is_powered = false

	if get_node_or_null("/root/EventBus") != null:
		EventBus.power_changed.emit(current_power_draw, total_power)

func _tick_power_and_systems(delta: float) -> void:
	if current_power_draw > 0.0 and reactor_energy > 0.0:
		var drain_rate: float = (current_power_draw / 100.0) * 1.2
		reactor_energy = maxf(0.0, reactor_energy - drain_rate * delta)
		if reactor_energy <= 0.0:
			calculate_power()

	var life_support_active: bool = false
	var thermal_active: bool = false

	for mod in active_modules:
		if not is_instance_valid(mod) or mod.is_broken or not mod.is_powered:
			continue
		if mod.module_name == "Life Support":
			life_support_active = true
		elif mod.module_name == "Thermal Control":
			thermal_active = true

	if life_support_active:
		oxygen_level = minf(100.0, oxygen_level + 3.5 * delta)
	else:
		oxygen_level = maxf(0.0, oxygen_level - 2.2 * delta)

	if thermal_active:
		temp_level = minf(100.0, temp_level + 3.0 * delta)
	else:
		temp_level = maxf(0.0, temp_level - 1.8 * delta)

	if oxygen_level <= 0.0 and get_node_or_null("/root/EventBus") != null:
		EventBus.game_over.emit("OXYGEN DEPLETED")
	elif temp_level <= 0.0 and get_node_or_null("/root/EventBus") != null:
		EventBus.game_over.emit("HYPOTHERMIA - THERMAL FAILURE")

func _tick_failure_dice(delta: float) -> void:
	_failure_timer += delta
	if _failure_timer < failure_roll_interval:
		return
	_failure_timer = 0.0

	var candidates: Array[BaseModule] = []
	for mod in active_modules:
		if is_instance_valid(mod) and mod.module_name != "Reactor" and not mod.is_broken and mod.is_powered:
			candidates.append(mod)

	if candidates.is_empty():
		return

	for mod in candidates:
		if randf() < failure_chance:
			mod.break_module()
			break

extends CanvasLayer

var overlay: ColorRect
var transitioning: bool = false

func _ready() -> void:
	layer = 100
	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	overlay = ColorRect.new()
	overlay.color = Color.BLACK
	overlay.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	overlay.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	overlay.modulate.a = 0.0
	add_child(overlay)

func fade_to_black(duration: float = 0.8) -> void:
	overlay.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
	var tw := create_tween()
	tw.tween_property(overlay, "modulate:a", 1.0, duration)
	await tw.finished

func fade_from_black(duration: float = 0.8) -> void:
	var tw := create_tween()
	tw.tween_property(overlay, "modulate:a", 0.0, duration)
	await tw.finished
	overlay.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE

func change_scene(path: String, duration: float = 0.8) -> void:
	if transitioning:
		return
	transitioning = true
	await fade_to_black(duration)
	get_tree().change_scene_to_file(path)
	await get_tree().process_frame
	await fade_from_black(duration)
	transitioning = false

extends CharacterBody2D
## PLAYER
##   SPACE            toggle build mode (you can still walk around in it)
##   E (interact)     in build mode: place + start building  |  outside: wires
##   SCROLL / TAB     swap which module you're about to place
## The build ghost is ALWAYS placed directly ahead of the way you're facing.

# â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ tuning â”€â”€
@export_group("Movement")
@export var speed: float = 300.0
@export var acceleration: float = 2600.0
@export var friction: float = 3400.0

@export_group("Animation")
## true  = you have idle_up / idle_down / idle_left / idle_right
## false = you only have idle_up / idle_down (left/right idle falls back to the last up/down idle)
@export var all_idles: bool = false

@export_group("Wires")
@export var grab_range: float = 150.0
@export var plug_range: float = 90.0
@export var pickup_range: float = 80.0

@export_group("Build")
@export var build_gap: float = 24.0        ## empty space between you and the ghost
@export var build_grid: float = 32.0       ## placement grid
@export var player_radius: float = 18.0
@export var ghost_glide: float = 22.0
@export var build_radius: float = 300.0    ## higher = ghost snaps faster

@export_group("Juice")
@export var camera_lookahead: float = 46.0

const BUILD_ACTION := &"build_mode"
const DIR_ACTIONS: Dictionary = {"up": "ui_up", "down": "ui_down", "left": "ui_left", "right": "ui_right"}
const DIR_VECS: Dictionary = {"up": Vector2.UP, "down": Vector2.DOWN, "left": Vector2.LEFT, "right": Vector2.RIGHT}
const C_CYAN := Color(0.3, 0.85, 1.0)
const C_GREEN := Color(0.4, 1.0, 0.55)
const C_RED := Color(1.0, 0.3, 0.25)
const C_AMBER := Color(1.0, 0.85, 0.3)

@onready var anim_player: AnimationPlayer = get_node_or_null("AnimationPlayer")
@onready var player_camera: Camera2D = get_node_or_null("PlayerCamera")
@onready var sprite: Sprite2D = get_node_or_null("Sprite2D")

# state (names kept so other scripts keep working)
var is_active: bool = false
var current_wire: Node2D = null
var facing_dir: String = "down"
var facing_vec: Vector2 = Vector2.DOWN
var held_dirs: Array[String] = []
var is_build_mode: bool = false
var build_options: Array[Dictionary] = []
var selected_module_index: int = 0
var ghost_module: Node2D = null
var can_place: bool = false

var _last_vertical := "down"
var _move_vel := Vector2.ZERO
var _t := 0.0
var _font: SystemFont

# juice state
var _sq := Vector2.ONE
var _sq_vel := Vector2.ZERO
var _walk_t := 0.0
var _trauma := 0.0
var _sprite_base_scale := Vector2.ONE
var _sprite_base_pos := Vector2.ZERO
var _sprite_half_h := 24.0
var _cam_base := Vector2.ZERO
var _dust: CPUParticles2D

# ghost state
var _ghost_origin := Vector2.ZERO
var _ghost_half := Vector2(64, 64)
var _ghost_center_off := Vector2.ZERO
var _ghost_test_shape: Shape2D = null
var _ghost_flash := 0.0
var _hud: CanvasLayer
var _build_panel: PanelContainer
var _build_title: Label
var _build_hint: Label
var _toast: Label
var _hud_key := ""
var _panel_ok: StyleBoxFlat
var _panel_bad: StyleBoxFlat

# â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ setup â”€â”€
func _ready() -> void:
	add_to_group("player")
	visible = false
	set_physics_process(false)
	_font = SystemFont.new()
	_font.font_names = PackedStringArray(["Courier New", "monospace"])
	_ensure_build_action()
	if sprite != null:
		_sprite_base_scale = sprite.scale
		_sprite_base_pos = sprite.position
		if sprite.texture != null:
			_sprite_half_h = float(sprite.texture.get_height()) / maxf(1.0, float(sprite.vframes)) * 0.5 * absf(sprite.scale.y)
	if player_camera != null:
		_cam_base = player_camera.position
	_make_dust()
	_make_build_hud()

func _exit_tree() -> void:
	if is_instance_valid(ghost_module):
		ghost_module.queue_free()
	if is_instance_valid(_hud):
		_hud.queue_free()

func _ensure_build_action() -> void:
	if InputMap.has_action(BUILD_ACTION):
		return
	InputMap.add_action(BUILD_ACTION)
	var ev := InputEventKey.new()
	ev.physical_keycode = KEY_SPACE
	InputMap.action_add_event(BUILD_ACTION, ev)

func enable_player() -> void:
	is_active = true
	visible = true
	set_physics_process(true)
	position = Vector2(320, 600)
	velocity = Vector2.ZERO
	_move_vel = Vector2.ZERO
	if player_camera != null:
		player_camera.enabled = true
	# materialise effect
	_pop(-0.3)
	Fx.burst(get_parent(), global_position, Color(0.5, 1.4, 1.8, 0.9), 26, 60.0, 180.0, 0.7, 0.04, 0.1, true)
	Ring.spawn(get_parent(), global_position, Color(0.4, 1.3, 1.6), 90.0, 0.55)

# â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ per-frame â”€â”€
func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	if not is_active:
		return

	var input_dir: Vector2 = Input.get_vector("ui_left", "ui_right", "ui_up", "ui_down")
	_update_facing()

	# smooth acceleration / friction (stored separately so wire tension keeps working as before)
	var rate := acceleration if input_dir != Vector2.ZERO else friction
	_move_vel = _move_vel.move_toward(input_dir * speed, rate * delta)
	velocity = _move_vel

	if current_wire != null and is_instance_valid(current_wire) and current_wire.has_method("apply_tension_to_player"):
		var did_snap: bool = current_wire.apply_tension_to_player(self, delta)
		if did_snap:
			current_wire.drop(global_position)
			current_wire = null
			_pop(-0.18)
			shake(0.25)

	move_and_slide()
	_update_animation(input_dir)

	if is_build_mode:
		_update_build_ghost(delta)

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	_t += delta
	var d := minf(delta, 0.05)
	_update_squash(d)
	_update_camera(d)
	if is_build_mode:
		_update_hud_text()
		queue_redraw()

# â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ facing â”€â”€
func _update_facing() -> void:
	for i in range(held_dirs.size() - 1, -1, -1):
		if not Input.is_action_pressed(DIR_ACTIONS[held_dirs[i]]):
			held_dirs.remove_at(i)
	for dname: String in DIR_ACTIONS.keys():
		var action: String = DIR_ACTIONS[dname]
		if Input.is_action_just_pressed(action):
			held_dirs.erase(dname)
			held_dirs.append(dname)
		elif Input.is_action_pressed(action) and not held_dirs.has(dname):
			held_dirs.append(dname)
	if not held_dirs.is_empty():
		var nd: String = held_dirs.back()
		if nd != facing_dir:
			_pop(0.07)
			Fx.burst(get_parent(), global_position + Vector2(0, _sprite_half_h * 0.8), Color(0.7, 0.75, 0.85, 0.35), 4, 10.0, 40.0, 0.35, 0.1, 0.22)
		facing_dir = nd
	facing_vec = DIR_VECS[facing_dir]
	if facing_dir == "up" or facing_dir == "down":
		_last_vertical = facing_dir

func _update_animation(input_dir: Vector2) -> void:
	if anim_player == null:
		return
	var moving := input_dir != Vector2.ZERO
	var anim_name := ""
	if moving:
		anim_name = "walk_" + facing_dir
		anim_player.speed_scale = clampf(_move_vel.length() / speed * 1.1, 0.6, 1.2)
	else:
		var d := facing_dir
		if not all_idles and (d == "left" or d == "right"):
			d = _last_vertical
		anim_name = "idle_" + d
		anim_player.speed_scale = 1.0
		if not anim_player.has_animation(anim_name):
			anim_name = "idle_down"
	if anim_player.has_animation(anim_name) and anim_player.current_animation != anim_name:
		anim_player.play(anim_name)

# â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ juice â”€â”€
func _pop(amount: float) -> void:
	# amount > 0 = squash (wide + short), amount < 0 = stretch (tall + thin)
	_sq_vel += Vector2(amount, -amount) * 15.0

func shake(amount: float) -> void:
	_trauma = minf(1.0, _trauma + amount)

func _update_squash(d: float) -> void:
	_sq_vel += (Vector2.ONE - _sq) * 220.0 * d
	_sq_vel *= maxf(0.0, 1.0 - 14.0 * d)
	_sq += _sq_vel * d
	var spd := _move_vel.length() / speed
	var moving := spd > 0.1
	if moving:
		_walk_t += d * 14.0 * spd
	var bob := sin(_walk_t) * 0.035 * spd if moving else 0.0
	var sc := Vector2(_sq.x - bob, _sq.y + bob)
	if sprite != null:
		sprite.scale = _sprite_base_scale * sc
		sprite.position = _sprite_base_pos + Vector2(0.0, (1.0 - sc.y) * _sprite_half_h)
		sprite.rotation = lerp_angle(sprite.rotation, clampf(_move_vel.x / speed, -1.0, 1.0) * 0.07, 1.0 - exp(-12.0 * d))
	if _dust != null:
		_dust.emitting = is_active and spd > 0.5
		_dust.position = Vector2(0.0, _sprite_half_h * 0.85)
		if moving:
			_dust.direction = -_move_vel.normalized()

func _update_camera(d: float) -> void:
	if player_camera == null:
		return
	var look := facing_vec * camera_lookahead * clampf(_move_vel.length() / speed + 0.25, 0.0, 1.0)
	player_camera.position = player_camera.position.lerp(_cam_base + look, 1.0 - exp(-4.0 * d))
	if _trauma > 0.0:
		_trauma = maxf(0.0, _trauma - 1.8 * d)
		var s := _trauma * _trauma * 14.0
		player_camera.offset = Vector2(randf_range(-1.0, 1.0), randf_range(-1.0, 1.0)) * s
	elif player_camera.offset != Vector2.ZERO and _trauma <= 0.0:
		player_camera.offset = player_camera.offset.lerp(Vector2.ZERO, 0.5)

func _make_dust() -> void:
	_dust = CPUParticles2D.new()
	_dust.texture = Fx.tex()
	_dust.amount = 14
	_dust.lifetime = 0.45
	_dust.local_coords = false
	_dust.show_behind_parent = true
	_dust.emitting = false
	_dust.spread = 35.0
	_dust.initial_velocity_min = 12.0
	_dust.initial_velocity_max = 42.0
	_dust.scale_amount_min = 0.08
	_dust.scale_amount_max = 0.2
	_dust.color = Color(0.75, 0.8, 0.9, 0.4)
	var g := Gradient.new()
	g.set_color(0, Color(1, 1, 1, 1))
	g.set_color(1, Color(1, 1, 1, 0))
	_dust.color_ramp = g
	add_child(_dust)

# â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ input â”€â”€
func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if not is_active:
		return
	if event.is_action_pressed(BUILD_ACTION):
		_toggle_build_mode()
		get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
		return
	if event.is_action_pressed("interact"):
		if is_build_mode:
			_attempt_place()
		else:
			_try_interact()
		return
	if is_build_mode:
		if event is InputEventMouseButton and event.pressed:
			if event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_UP:
				_cycle_ghost(-1)
			elif event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_DOWN:
				_cycle_ghost(1)
			elif event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
				_attempt_place()
		elif event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and not event.echo and event.keycode == KEY_TAB:
			_cycle_ghost(1)

# â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ build mode â”€â”€
func _toggle_build_mode() -> void:
	if is_build_mode:
		_exit_build_mode()
		return
	_refresh_build_options()
	if build_options.is_empty():
		_flash_hint("NOTHING TO BUILD - buy modules in the manifest first", C_AMBER)
		_pop(0.08)
		return
	is_build_mode = true
	_spawn_ghost()
	_set_build_hud(true)
	_pop(-0.12)

func _exit_build_mode() -> void:
	is_build_mode = false
	_clear_ghost()
	_set_build_hud(false)
	_pop(0.06)
	queue_redraw()

func _refresh_build_options() -> void:
	var prev_id := ""
	if selected_module_index < build_options.size():
		prev_id = build_options[selected_module_index]["id"]
	build_options.clear()
	selected_module_index = 0
	for item_data in GameManager.catalog:
		var item_id = item_data["id"]
		if GameManager.get_item_count(item_id) > 0:
			var scene = load(item_data["scene_path"])
			if scene != null:
				build_options.append({"id": item_id, "scene": scene})
				if item_id == prev_id:
					selected_module_index = build_options.size() - 1

func _cycle_ghost(dir: int) -> void:
	if build_options.size() < 2:
		return
	selected_module_index = posmod(selected_module_index + dir, build_options.size())
	_spawn_ghost()
	_pop(0.06)

func _clear_ghost() -> void:
	if is_instance_valid(ghost_module):
		ghost_module.queue_free()
	ghost_module = null
	_ghost_test_shape = null

func _spawn_ghost() -> void:
	_clear_ghost()
	if build_options.is_empty():
		return
	var option: Dictionary = build_options[selected_module_index]
	var g = option["scene"].instantiate()
	g.set_meta("is_ghost", true)
	g.set("is_constructing", true)            # stops BaseModule._ready from registering the preview
	g.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED
	g.z_index = 20
	get_parent().add_child(g)
	_neutralize_ghost(g)
	ghost_module = g
	# measure the module's footprint from its collision shape
	_ghost_half = Vector2(64, 64)
	_ghost_center_off = Vector2.ZERO
	_ghost_test_shape = null
	var col := g.get_node_or_null("CollisionShape2D") as CollisionShape2D
	if col != null and col.shape != null:
		_ghost_center_off = col.position
		if col.shape is RectangleShape2D:
			var sz: Vector2 = (col.shape as RectangleShape2D).size
			_ghost_half = sz * 0.5
			var ts := RectangleShape2D.new()
			ts.size = sz - Vector2(6, 6)       # tiny shrink so flush neighbours don't count as overlap
			_ghost_test_shape = ts
		else:
			_ghost_test_shape = col.shape
			_ghost_half = Vector2(48, 48)
	_update_build_ghost(0.0, true)
	g.modulate.a = 0.0
	_hud_key = ""

## The preview must not collide, be interactable, or be treated as a wire target.
func _neutralize_ghost(n: Node) -> void:
	if n is CollisionObject2D:
		(n as CollisionObject2D).collision_layer = 0
		(n as CollisionObject2D).collision_mask = 0
	if n is Area2D:
		(n as Area2D).monitoring = false
		(n as Area2D).monitorable = false
	for grp in n.get_groups():
		if not str(grp).begins_with("_"):
			n.remove_from_group(grp)
	for c in n.get_children():
		_neutralize_ghost(c)

static func _snap_out(v: float, dir: float, grid: float) -> float:
	if dir > 0.0:
		return ceilf(v / grid) * grid
	if dir < 0.0:
		return floorf(v / grid) * grid
	return roundf(v / grid) * grid

func _update_build_ghost(delta: float, snap_now: bool = false) -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(ghost_module):
		return
	var to_mouse := get_global_mouse_position() - global_position
	if to_mouse.length() > build_radius:
		to_mouse = to_mouse.normalized() * build_radius
	var center := global_position + to_mouse
	var origin := center - _ghost_center_off
	_ghost_origin = origin
 
	if snap_now or ghost_module.global_position.distance_to(origin) > 700.0:
		ghost_module.global_position = origin
	else:
		ghost_module.global_position = ghost_module.global_position.lerp(origin, 1.0 - exp(-ghost_glide * delta))
 
	can_place = true
	if _ghost_test_shape != null:
		var q := PhysicsShapeQueryParameters2D.new()
		q.shape = _ghost_test_shape
		q.transform = Transform2D(0.0, origin + _ghost_center_off)
		q.collide_with_bodies = true
		q.collide_with_areas = false
		q.exclude = [get_rid()]
		can_place = get_world_2d().direct_space_state.intersect_shape(q, 1).is_empty()
	if can_place:
		var rc := Rect2(center - _ghost_half, _ghost_half * 2.0)
		var cp := Vector2(clampf(global_position.x, rc.position.x, rc.end.x), clampf(global_position.y, rc.position.y, rc.end.y))
		if cp.distance_to(global_position) < player_radius + 6.0:
			can_place = false
 
	var pulse := 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(_t * 6.0)
	var a := lerpf(ghost_module.modulate.a, 0.5 + 0.2 * pulse, 0.25)
	_ghost_flash = maxf(0.0, _ghost_flash - delta)
	if _ghost_flash > 0.0:
		ghost_module.modulate = Color(2.2, 0.35, 0.35, 0.85)
	elif can_place:
		ghost_module.modulate = Color(0.55, 1.0, 1.3, a)
	else:
		ghost_module.modulate = Color(1.4, 0.3, 0.3, a)
func _draw() -> void:
	if not is_build_mode:
		return
	var pulse := 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(_t * 3.0)
	draw_arc(Vector2.ZERO, build_radius, 0.0, TAU, 96, Color(0.3, 0.85, 1.0, 0.16 + 0.1 * pulse), 2.0, true)
	var n := 48
	for i in n:
		if i % 2 == 0:
			var a := TAU * i / n + _t * 0.15
			draw_arc(Vector2.ZERO, build_radius - 6.0, a, a + TAU / n * 0.9, 4, Color(0.4, 1.2, 1.5, 0.35), 3.0, true)
 
func _deny() -> void:
	_ghost_flash = 0.25
	_sq_vel.x += 3.5 * (1.0 if randf() > 0.5 else -1.0)
	shake(0.18)
	_flash_hint("BLOCKED - something is in the way", C_RED)

func _attempt_place() -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(ghost_module) or build_options.is_empty():
		return
	if not can_place:
		_deny()
		return
	var option: Dictionary = build_options[selected_module_index]
	var item_name: String = option["id"]
	if not GameManager.remove_from_inventory(item_name):
		_deny()
		return

	var parent_node := get_parent()
	var m = option["scene"].instantiate()
	m.set("is_constructing", true)           # BaseManager registration happens in _finish_build()
	var p2d := parent_node as Node2D
	m.position = p2d.to_local(_ghost_origin) if p2d != null else _ghost_origin
	parent_node.add_child(m)
	m.start_construction()
	# BaseModule measures "nearby" from the module's top-left origin; widen it so standing
	# anywhere around the footprint (incl. where you placed it from) keeps the build going
	m.proximity_distance = maxf(m.proximity_distance, _ghost_origin.distance_to(global_position) + 140.0)

	var fx := ConstructionFX.new()
	fx.setup(m, self, _ghost_center_off, _ghost_half, _font)
	parent_node.add_child(fx)

	# juice
	var c := _ghost_origin + _ghost_center_off
	Fx.burst(parent_node, c, Color(0.75, 0.78, 0.85, 0.55), 22, 40.0, 150.0, 0.9, 0.3, 0.7)
	Fx.burst(parent_node, c, Color(1.6, 1.2, 0.5, 1.0), 16, 80.0, 220.0, 0.5, 0.04, 0.09, true, Vector2(0, 260))
	Ring.spawn(parent_node, c, Color(0.4, 1.3, 1.6), maxf(_ghost_half.x, _ghost_half.y) * 1.5, 0.5)
	_pop(0.2)
	shake(0.35)
	_flash_hint("BUILDING %s - stay close!" % item_name.to_upper(), C_GREEN)

	_refresh_build_options()
	if build_options.is_empty():
		_exit_build_mode()
	else:
		_spawn_ghost()

# â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ build HUD â”€â”€
func _box(border: Color) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var s := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	s.bg_color = Color(0.05, 0.08, 0.12, 0.92)
	s.border_color = border
	s.set_border_width_all(2)
	s.set_corner_radius_all(6)
	s.shadow_color = Color(border.r, border.g, border.b, 0.3)
	s.shadow_size = 14
	s.content_margin_left = 18
	s.content_margin_right = 18
	s.content_margin_top = 10
	s.content_margin_bottom = 10
	return s

func _lbl(size: int, col: Color) -> Label:
	var l := Label.new()
	var ls := LabelSettings.new()
	ls.font = _font
	ls.font_size = size
	ls.font_color = col
	ls.outline_size = 3
	ls.outline_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.8)
	l.label_settings = ls
	l.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	l.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	return l

func _make_build_hud() -> void:
	_hud = CanvasLayer.new()
	_hud.layer = 15
	_panel_ok = _box(Color(0.3, 0.85, 1.0, 0.85))
	_panel_bad = _box(Color(1.0, 0.3, 0.25, 0.9))
	_build_panel = PanelContainer.new()
	_build_panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", _panel_ok)
	_build_panel.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	_build_panel.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_CENTER_BOTTOM)
	_build_panel.grow_horizontal = Control.GROW_DIRECTION_BOTH
	_build_panel.grow_vertical = Control.GROW_DIRECTION_BEGIN
	_build_panel.offset_top = -40
	_build_panel.offset_bottom = -40
	_build_panel.visible = false
	var vb := VBoxContainer.new()
	vb.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 4)
	_build_title = _lbl(20, C_CYAN)
	_build_hint = _lbl(14, Color(0.75, 0.82, 0.88))
	_build_hint.text = "[E] BUILD     [SPACE] EXIT     [SCROLL / TAB] SWAP"
	vb.add_child(_build_title)
	vb.add_child(_build_hint)
	_build_panel.add_child(vb)
	_hud.add_child(_build_panel)
	_toast = _lbl(18, C_AMBER)
	_toast.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_CENTER_BOTTOM)
	_toast.grow_horizontal = Control.GROW_DIRECTION_BOTH
	_toast.grow_vertical = Control.GROW_DIRECTION_BEGIN
	_toast.offset_top = -130
	_toast.offset_bottom = -130
	_toast.modulate.a = 0.0
	_hud.add_child(_toast)
	add_child.call_deferred(_hud)

func _set_build_hud(on: bool) -> void:
	if _build_panel == null:
		return
	_build_panel.visible = on
	if on:
		_build_panel.modulate.a = 0.0
		create_tween().tween_property(_build_panel, "modulate:a", 1.0, 0.15)
	_hud_key = ""

func _update_hud_text() -> void:
	if _build_title == null or build_options.is_empty() or selected_module_index >= build_options.size():
		return
	var id: String = build_options[selected_module_index]["id"]
	var key := "%s|%d|%s" % [id, GameManager.get_item_count(id), str(can_place)]
	if key == _hud_key:
		return
	_hud_key = key
	var txt := "BUILD MODE  -  %s  x%d" % [id.to_upper(), GameManager.get_item_count(id)]
	if not can_place:
		txt += "  -  BLOCKED"
	_build_title.text = txt
	(_build_title.label_settings as LabelSettings).font_color = C_CYAN if can_place else C_RED
	_build_panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", _panel_ok if can_place else _panel_bad)

func _flash_hint(text: String, col: Color) -> void:
	if _toast == null:
		return
	_toast.text = text
	(_toast.label_settings as LabelSettings).font_color = col
	_toast.modulate.a = 1.0
	var tw := create_tween()
	tw.tween_interval(1.4)
	tw.tween_property(_toast, "modulate:a", 0.0, 0.5)

# â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ wires â”€â”€
func _broken_module_in_reach() -> bool:
	for m in BaseManager.active_modules:
		if is_instance_valid(m) and m.is_broken and m.global_position.distance_to(global_position) <= m.proximity_distance:
			return true
	return false

func _try_interact() -> void:
	# E also repairs broken modules (hold). Don't grab wires while you're trying to fix something.
	if current_wire == null and _broken_module_in_reach():
		return

	if current_wire != null:
		var receiver: Node2D = _find_nearby_receiver()
		if receiver != null:
			receiver.accept_wire(current_wire)
			current_wire.plug_in(receiver)
			current_wire = null
			var rp: Vector2 = receiver.get_receiver_position() if receiver.has_method("get_receiver_position") else receiver.global_position
			Fx.burst(get_parent(), rp, Color(1.2, 3.0, 3.6, 1.0), 14, 40.0, 140.0, 0.45, 0.04, 0.09, true)
			Ring.spawn(get_parent(), rp, Color(0.4, 1.3, 1.6), 44.0, 0.35)
			_pop(0.14)
			shake(0.12)
		else:
			current_wire.drop(global_position)
			current_wire = null
			_pop(0.08)
		return

	var dropped_wire: Node2D = _find_closest_dropped_wire()
	if dropped_wire != null:
		current_wire = dropped_wire
		current_wire.pick_up(global_position)
		_grab_fx()
		return

	var plugged_wire: Node2D = _find_closest_plugged_wire()
	if plugged_wire != null:
		if is_instance_valid(plugged_wire.plugged_receiver) and plugged_wire.plugged_receiver.has_method("remove_wire"):
			plugged_wire.plugged_receiver.remove_wire(plugged_wire)
		current_wire = plugged_wire
		current_wire.pick_up(global_position)
		_grab_fx()
		return

	var source: Node2D = _find_closest_wire_source()
	if source != null:
		var new_wire: Node2D = source.spawn_wire()
		if new_wire != null:
			current_wire = new_wire
			current_wire.pick_up(global_position)
			_grab_fx()

func _grab_fx() -> void:
	_pop(-0.14)
	Fx.burst(get_parent(), global_position + facing_vec * 20.0, Color(1.4, 1.4, 1.6, 0.9), 8, 30.0, 90.0, 0.3, 0.03, 0.06, true)

func _get_all_wires() -> Array[Node]:
	return get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("wires")

func _find_closest_dropped_wire() -> Node2D:
	var closest_wire: Node2D = null
	var min_dist: float = pickup_range
	for node in _get_all_wires():
		if node is Node2D and node.has_method("pick_up") and not node.is_held and not node.is_plugged:
			var dist: float = global_position.distance_to(node.hand_pos)
			if dist <= min_dist:
				min_dist = dist
				closest_wire = node
	return closest_wire

func _find_closest_plugged_wire() -> Node2D:
	var closest_wire: Node2D = null
	var min_dist: float = pickup_range
	for node in _get_all_wires():
		if node is Node2D and node.has_method("pick_up") and not node.is_held and node.is_plugged:
			var dist: float = global_position.distance_to(node.hand_pos)
			if dist <= min_dist:
				min_dist = dist
				closest_wire = node
	return closest_wire

func _find_closest_wire_source() -> Node2D:
	var closest_source: Node2D = null
	var min_dist: float = grab_range
	for node in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("wire_sources"):
		if node is Node2D and node.has_method("spawn_wire") and node.has_method("can_spawn_wire"):
			if not node.can_spawn_wire():
				continue
			var dist: float = global_position.distance_to(node.global_position)
			if dist <= min_dist:
				min_dist = dist
				closest_source = node
	return closest_source

func _find_nearby_receiver() -> Node2D:
	var closest_receiver: Node2D = null
	var min_dist: float = plug_range
	for node in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("wire_receivers"):
		if node is Node2D and node.has_method("can_accept_wire") and node.can_accept_wire():
			var target_pos: Vector2 = node.get_receiver_position() if node.has_method("get_receiver_position") else node.global_position
			var dist: float = global_position.distance_to(target_pos)
			if dist <= min_dist:
				min_dist = dist
				closest_receiver = node
	if closest_receiver != null:
		return closest_receiver

	var shape: CircleShape2D = CircleShape2D.new()
	shape.radius = plug_range
	var query: PhysicsShapeQueryParameters2D = PhysicsShapeQueryParameters2D.new()
	query.shape = shape
	query.transform = Transform2D(0.0, global_position)
	query.collide_with_areas = true
	query.collide_with_bodies = false
	query.collision_mask = 1
	var hits: Array[Dictionary] = get_world_2d().direct_space_state.intersect_shape(query, 16)
	for hit in hits:
		var area: Object = hit.get("collider")
		if area is Area2D and area.name == "InteractArea":
			var module: Node = area.get_parent()
			if module is BaseModule:
				for child in module.get_children():
					if child is Node2D and child.is_in_group("wire_receivers") and child.can_accept_wire():
						var target_pos: Vector2 = child.get_receiver_position()
						var dist: float = global_position.distance_to(target_pos)
						if dist < min_dist:
							min_dist = dist
							closest_receiver = child
	return closest_receiver

# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â• effect helpers â•â•
class Fx:
	static var _soft: GradientTexture2D = null
	static func tex() -> GradientTexture2D:
		if _soft == null:
			var g := Gradient.new()
			g.set_color(0, Color(1, 1, 1, 1))
			g.set_color(1, Color(1, 1, 1, 0))
			g.add_point(0.35, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.55))
			_soft = GradientTexture2D.new()
			_soft.gradient = g
			_soft.fill = GradientTexture2D.FILL_RADIAL
			_soft.fill_from = Vector2(0.5, 0.5)
			_soft.fill_to = Vector2(1.0, 0.5)
			_soft.width = 64
			_soft.height = 64
		return _soft

	## fire-and-forget one-shot particle burst (frees itself)
	static func burst(parent: Node, pos: Vector2, col: Color, amount: int, v_min: float, v_max: float, life: float, s_min: float, s_max: float, additive: bool = false, grav: Vector2 = Vector2.ZERO) -> void:
		if parent == null or not parent.is_inside_tree():
			return
		var p := CPUParticles2D.new()
		p.texture = tex()
		p.one_shot = true
		p.explosiveness = 0.95
		p.amount = amount
		p.lifetime = life
		p.spread = 180.0
		p.initial_velocity_min = v_min
		p.initial_velocity_max = v_max
		p.gravity = grav
		p.scale_amount_min = s_min
		p.scale_amount_max = s_max
		p.color = col
		p.local_coords = false
		p.z_index = 70
		var g := Gradient.new()
		g.set_color(0, Color(1, 1, 1, 1))
		g.set_color(1, Color(1, 1, 1, 0))
		p.color_ramp = g
		if additive:
			var m := CanvasItemMaterial.new()
			m.blend_mode = CanvasItemMaterial.BLEND_MODE_ADD
			p.material = m
		parent.add_child(p)
		p.global_position = pos
		p.emitting = true
		parent.get_tree().create_timer(life + 0.4).timeout.connect(p.queue_free)

class Ring extends Node2D:
	var r := 4.0
	var a := 1.0
	var w := 4.0
	var col := Color(0.4, 1.3, 1.6)
	func _process(_d: float) -> void:
		queue_redraw()
	func _draw() -> void:
		draw_arc(Vector2.ZERO, r, 0.0, TAU, 56, Color(col.r, col.g, col.b, a), w, true)
	static func spawn(parent: Node, pos: Vector2, color: Color, max_r: float, dur: float) -> void:
		if parent == null or not parent.is_inside_tree():
			return
		var ring := Ring.new()
		ring.col = color
		ring.z_index = 80
		var m := CanvasItemMaterial.new()
		m.blend_mode = CanvasItemMaterial.BLEND_MODE_ADD
		ring.material = m
		parent.add_child(ring)
		ring.global_position = pos
		var tw := ring.create_tween().set_parallel(true)
		tw.tween_property(ring, "r", max_r, dur).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_CUBIC).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
		tw.tween_property(ring, "a", 0.0, dur)
		tw.tween_property(ring, "w", 1.0, dur)
		tw.chain().tween_callback(ring.queue_free)

## Lives next to a module while it's being built: smoke + sparks while you're in range,
## a nice drawn progress bar, and a pop + flash when it finishes.
class ConstructionFX extends Node2D:
	var target: BaseModule
	var player: Node2D
	var half := Vector2(64, 64)
	var center := Vector2.ZERO
	var font: SystemFont
	var smoke: CPUParticles2D
	var sparks: CPUParticles2D
	var shown := 0.0
	var near := true
	var t := 0.0
	var bg_style: StyleBoxFlat
	var fill_style: StyleBoxFlat

	func setup(m: Node, p: Node2D, center_off: Vector2, half_size: Vector2, f: SystemFont) -> void:
		target = m
		player = p
		center = center_off
		half = half_size
		font = f
		z_index = 90
		global_position = m.global_position + center

		bg_style = StyleBoxFlat.new()
		bg_style.bg_color = Color(0.04, 0.06, 0.09, 0.92)
		bg_style.border_color = Color(0.3, 0.85, 1.0, 0.8)
		bg_style.set_border_width_all(1)
		bg_style.set_corner_radius_all(4)
		bg_style.shadow_color = Color(0.3, 0.85, 1.0, 0.25)
		bg_style.shadow_size = 8
		fill_style = StyleBoxFlat.new()
		fill_style.set_corner_radius_all(3)

		smoke = CPUParticles2D.new()
		smoke.texture = Fx.tex()
		smoke.amount = 26
		smoke.lifetime = 2.2
		smoke.local_coords = false
		smoke.emission_shape = CPUParticles2D.EMISSION_SHAPE_RECTANGLE
		smoke.emission_rect_extents = Vector2(half.x * 0.8, half.y * 0.5)
		smoke.direction = Vector2(0, -1)
		smoke.spread = 25.0
		smoke.initial_velocity_min = 14.0
		smoke.initial_velocity_max = 34.0
		smoke.gravity = Vector2(0, -6)
		smoke.scale_amount_min = 0.5
		smoke.scale_amount_max = 0.9
		var cv := Curve.new()
		cv.add_point(Vector2(0, 0.4))
		cv.add_point(Vector2(1, 1.7))
		smoke.scale_amount_curve = cv
		smoke.color = Color(0.72, 0.75, 0.82, 0.5)
		var g := Gradient.new()
		g.set_color(0, Color(1, 1, 1, 0))
		g.set_color(1, Color(1, 1, 1, 0))
		g.add_point(0.2, Color(1, 1, 1, 1))
		smoke.color_ramp = g
		smoke.emitting = false
		add_child(smoke)

		sparks = CPUParticles2D.new()
		sparks.texture = Fx.tex()
		sparks.amount = 14
		sparks.lifetime = 0.55
		sparks.local_coords = false
		sparks.emission_shape = CPUParticles2D.EMISSION_SHAPE_RECTANGLE
		sparks.emission_rect_extents = half * 0.9
		sparks.direction = Vector2(0, -1)
		sparks.spread = 180.0
		sparks.initial_velocity_min = 40.0
		sparks.initial_velocity_max = 120.0
		sparks.gravity = Vector2(0, 220)
		sparks.scale_amount_min = 0.03
		sparks.scale_amount_max = 0.07
		sparks.color = Color(1.8, 1.2, 0.5, 1.0)
		var g2 := Gradient.new()
		g2.set_color(0, Color(1, 1, 1, 1))
		g2.set_color(1, Color(1, 1, 1, 0))
		sparks.color_ramp = g2
		var mat := CanvasItemMaterial.new()
		mat.blend_mode = CanvasItemMaterial.BLEND_MODE_ADD
		sparks.material = mat
		sparks.emitting = false
		add_child(sparks)

	func _process(delta: float) -> void:
		if not is_instance_valid(target):
			queue_free()
			return
		t += delta
		global_position = target.global_position + center
		if not target.is_constructing:
			_finish()
			return
		near = is_instance_valid(player) and target.global_position.distance_to(player.global_position) <= target.proximity_distance
		smoke.emitting = near
		sparks.emitting = near
		shown = lerpf(shown, clampf(target.build_progress / 100.0, 0.0, 1.0), 1.0 - exp(-10.0 * delta))
		# our own bar replaces the default one; the module "materialises" as it builds
		if target.progress_bar != null:
			target.progress_bar.visible = false
		var shimmer := 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(t * 8.0)
		target.modulate = Color(1.0 + 0.12 * shimmer, 1.0 + 0.12 * shimmer, 1.0 + 0.12 * shimmer, 0.35 + 0.5 * shown)
		queue_redraw()

	func _finish() -> void:
		var par := get_parent()
		if is_instance_valid(target):
			target.modulate = Color(2.2, 2.2, 2.4, 1.0)
			target.create_tween().tween_property(target, "modulate", Color.WHITE, 0.45)
		Fx.burst(par, global_position, Color(0.8, 0.85, 0.95, 0.6), 26, 60.0, 200.0, 0.9, 0.3, 0.8)
		Fx.burst(par, global_position, Color(0.5, 1.6, 2.0, 1.0), 30, 100.0, 280.0, 0.7, 0.04, 0.1, true)
		Ring.spawn(par, global_position, Color(0.4, 1.4, 1.8), maxf(half.x, half.y) * 1.8, 0.6)
		if is_instance_valid(player):
			player.call("shake", 0.45)
			player.call("_pop", 0.16)
		queue_free()

	func _draw() -> void:
		var w := clampf(half.x * 1.6, 110.0, 220.0)
		var h := 14.0
		var pos := Vector2(-w * 0.5, -half.y - 36.0)
		draw_style_box(bg_style, Rect2(pos - Vector2(3, 3), Vector2(w + 6, h + 6)))
		var col := Color(0.4, 1.15, 0.55) if near else Color(1.1, 0.3, 0.25)
		fill_style.bg_color = col
		var fw := w * shown
		if fw > 1.0:
			draw_style_box(fill_style, Rect2(pos, Vector2(maxf(fw, 6.0), h)))
			var bx := pos.x + fposmod(t * 120.0, maxf(fw, 1.0))
			draw_rect(Rect2(bx, pos.y, minf(14.0, pos.x + fw - bx), h), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.3))
			draw_rect(Rect2(pos.x + fw - 2.0, pos.y, 2.0, h), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.9))
		var label := "BUILDING  %d%%" % int(shown * 100.0) if near else "RETURN TO CONTINUE BUILDING"
		draw_string(font, pos + Vector2(0, -8), label, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, w, 13, Color(col.r, col.g, col.b, 1.0))

extends BaseModule

var active_wires: Array = []

	module_name = "Reactor"
	can_accept_wires = true

func request_new_wire(player_pos: Vector2) -> Dictionary:
	var center = global_position + Vector2(64, 64)
	var dir = (player_pos - center).normalized()
	if dir == Vector2.ZERO: dir = Vector2.RIGHT
	var socket_pos = center + dir * 64.0

	var wire = Line2D.new()
	wire.top_level = true
	wire.width = 12.0
	wire.default_color = Color(0.8, 0.1, 0.1)
	wire.joint_mode = Line2D.LINE_JOINT_ROUND
	wire.begin_cap_mode = Line2D.LINE_CAP_ROUND
	wire.end_cap_mode = Line2D.LINE_CAP_ROUND
	wire.antialiased = true
	wire.z_index = 1
	get_parent().add_child(wire)

	var shadow = Line2D.new()
	shadow.top_level = true
	shadow.width = 16.0
	shadow.default_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.45)
	shadow.joint_mode = Line2D.LINE_JOINT_ROUND
	shadow.begin_cap_mode = Line2D.LINE_CAP_ROUND
	shadow.end_cap_mode = Line2D.LINE_CAP_ROUND
	shadow.antialiased = true
	shadow.position = Vector2(4, 6)
	shadow.z_index = -1
	get_parent().add_child(shadow)

	var wire_data = {
		"wire": wire,
		"shadow": shadow,
		"socket_pos": socket_pos,
		"is_active": true
	}
	active_wires.append(wire_data)
	return wire_data

func release_wire(wire_data: Dictionary) -> void:
	active_wires.erase(wire_data)
	if is_instance_valid(wire_data["wire"]): wire_data["wire"].queue_free()
	if is_instance_valid(wire_data["shadow"]): wire_data["shadow"].queue_free()

extends Node2D

@export var rope_segments: int = 24
@export var damping: float = 0.85
@export var max_length: float = 320.0
@export var stretch_limit: float = 110.0
@export var pull_strength: float = 14.0
@export var solver_iterations: int = 18
@export var collision_radius: float = 6.0

var is_held: bool = false
var is_plugged: bool = false
var is_dropped: bool = false

var source_node: Node2D = null
var source_module: BaseModule = null
var plugged_receiver: Node2D = null
var target_module: BaseModule = null

var wire_color: Color = Color(0.85, 0.15, 0.15)
var current_stretch_ratio: float = 0.0

var wire: Line2D
var shadow: Line2D

var socket_pos: Vector2 = Vector2.ZERO
var hand_pos: Vector2 = Vector2.ZERO

var rope_points: Array[Vector2] = []
var old_rope_points: Array[Vector2] = []
var ignored_rids: Array[RID] = []

var collision_shape: CircleShape2D
var shape_query: PhysicsShapeQueryParameters2D

var plug_body_style: StyleBoxFlat
var plug_boot_style: StyleBoxFlat
var plug_shadow_style: StyleBoxFlat

func _ready() -> void:
	top_level = true
	global_position = Vector2.ZERO
	z_index = 2
	add_to_group("wires")

	wire = $Line2D
	shadow = $Line2DShadow

	wire.width = 12.0
	wire.joint_mode = Line2D.LINE_JOINT_ROUND
	wire.begin_cap_mode = Line2D.LINE_CAP_ROUND
	wire.end_cap_mode = Line2D.LINE_CAP_ROUND
	wire.antialiased = true
	wire.default_color = wire_color
	wire.show_behind_parent = true

	shadow.width = 16.0
	shadow.joint_mode = Line2D.LINE_JOINT_ROUND
	shadow.begin_cap_mode = Line2D.LINE_CAP_ROUND
	shadow.end_cap_mode = Line2D.LINE_CAP_ROUND
	shadow.antialiased = true
	shadow.default_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.45)
	shadow.position = Vector2(4, 6)
	shadow.show_behind_parent = true
	shadow.z_index = -1

	collision_shape = CircleShape2D.new()
	collision_shape.radius = collision_radius

	shape_query = PhysicsShapeQueryParameters2D.new()
	shape_query.shape = collision_shape
	shape_query.collide_with_bodies = true
	shape_query.collide_with_areas = false
	shape_query.collision_mask = 1

	plug_body_style = StyleBoxFlat.new()
	plug_body_style.bg_color = Color(0.22, 0.24, 0.28)
	plug_body_style.border_color = Color(0.1, 0.11, 0.13)
	plug_body_style.set_border_width_all(2)
	plug_body_style.set_corner_radius_all(5)

	plug_boot_style = StyleBoxFlat.new()
	plug_boot_style.bg_color = Color(0.14, 0.15, 0.18)
	plug_boot_style.set_corner_radius_all(3)

	plug_shadow_style = StyleBoxFlat.new()
	plug_shadow_style.bg_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.45)
	plug_shadow_style.set_corner_radius_all(5)

func register_ignored_rid(rid: RID) -> void:
	if rid.is_valid() and not ignored_rids.has(rid):
		ignored_rids.append(rid)

func setup(start_pos: Vector2, custom_color: Color = Color(0.85, 0.15, 0.15), origin_source: Node2D = null) -> void:
	socket_pos = start_pos
	hand_pos = start_pos
	wire_color = custom_color
	source_node = origin_source
	if origin_source != null and origin_source.get_parent() is BaseModule:
		source_module = origin_source.get_parent() as BaseModule

	is_held = false
	is_plugged = false
	is_dropped = true
	plugged_receiver = null
	target_module = null

	if wire != null:
		wire.default_color = wire_color

	rope_points.clear()
	old_rope_points.clear()

	for i in range(rope_segments + 1):
		rope_points.append(start_pos)
		old_rope_points.append(start_pos)

func pick_up(player_pos: Vector2) -> void:
	is_held = true
	is_plugged = false
	is_dropped = false
	plugged_receiver = null
	target_module = null
	hand_pos = player_pos
	if wire != null:
		wire.default_color = wire_color

func drop(drop_pos: Vector2) -> void:
	is_held = false
	is_plugged = false
	is_dropped = true
	plugged_receiver = null
	target_module = null
	hand_pos = drop_pos
	if wire != null:
		wire.default_color = wire_color

func plug_in(receiver_node: Node2D) -> void:
	is_held = false
	is_plugged = true
	is_dropped = false
	plugged_receiver = receiver_node
	if receiver_node.get_parent() is BaseModule:
		target_module = receiver_node.get_parent() as BaseModule
	elif "target_module" in receiver_node:
		target_module = receiver_node.target_module

	if receiver_node.has_method("get_rid"):
		register_ignored_rid(receiver_node.call("get_rid"))
	if receiver_node.has_method("get_receiver_position"):
		hand_pos = receiver_node.get_receiver_position()
	else:
		hand_pos = receiver_node.global_position
	if wire != null:
		wire.default_color = wire_color

func get_total_rope_length() -> float:
	if rope_points.size() < 2:
		return 0.0
	var total: float = 0.0
	for i in range(rope_segments):
		total += rope_points[i].distance_to(rope_points[i + 1])
	return total

func apply_tension_to_player(player: CharacterBody2D, delta: float) -> bool:
	if rope_points.size() < 2:
		return false

	var total_len: float = get_total_rope_length()
	if total_len <= max_length:
		current_stretch_ratio = 0.0
		return false

	var over_stretch: float = total_len - max_length
	current_stretch_ratio = clampf(over_stretch / stretch_limit, 0.0, 1.0)

	var anchor_pt: Vector2 = rope_points[max(0, rope_segments - 2)]
	var pull_dir: Vector2 = (anchor_pt - player.global_position).normalized()

	player.velocity += pull_dir * (over_stretch * pull_strength)
	player.global_position += pull_dir * (over_stretch * 0.35 * delta * 60.0)

	if over_stretch > stretch_limit * 1.15:
		return true

	return false

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if is_instance_valid(source_node):
		socket_pos = source_node.global_position

	var player: Node2D = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("player") as Node2D
	if player == null and get_tree().current_scene != null:
		player = get_tree().current_scene.get_node_or_null("Player") as Node2D
	if player != null and player.has_method("get_rid"):
		register_ignored_rid(player.call("get_rid"))

	if is_held and player != null:
		hand_pos = player.global_position
	elif is_plugged and is_instance_valid(plugged_receiver):
		if plugged_receiver.has_method("get_receiver_position"):
			hand_pos = plugged_receiver.get_receiver_position()
		else:
			hand_pos = plugged_receiver.global_position

	_simulate_rope(delta)
	queue_redraw()

func _simulate_rope(_delta: float) -> void:
	if rope_points.is_empty():
		return

	var last_idx: int = rope_segments
	var end_locked: bool = is_held or is_plugged
	var rest_seg_len: float = max_length / float(rope_segments)

	for i in range(1, last_idx + 1):
		if i == last_idx and end_locked:
			continue
		var vel: Vector2 = (rope_points[i] - old_rope_points[i]) * damping
		old_rope_points[i] = rope_points[i]
		rope_points[i] += vel

	rope_points[0] = socket_pos
	if end_locked:
		rope_points[last_idx] = hand_pos
		old_rope_points[last_idx] = hand_pos

	var space_state: PhysicsDirectSpaceState2D = get_world_2d().direct_space_state
	shape_query.exclude = ignored_rids

	for iter in range(solver_iterations):
		for i in range(rope_segments):
			var delta_vec: Vector2 = rope_points[i + 1] - rope_points[i]
			var d: float = delta_vec.length()
			if d < 0.0001:
				continue

			var stiffness: float = 0.88 if d > rest_seg_len else 0.65
			var correction: Vector2 = (delta_vec / d) * (d - rest_seg_len) * stiffness

			if i == 0:
				rope_points[i + 1] -= correction
			elif i == last_idx - 1 and end_locked:
				rope_points[i] += correction
			else:
				rope_points[i] += correction * 0.5
				rope_points[i + 1] -= correction * 0.5

		rope_points[0] = socket_pos
		if end_locked:
			rope_points[last_idx] = hand_pos

		if iter % 2 == 0 or iter == solver_iterations - 1:
			_solve_collisions(space_state, end_locked)

	if is_dropped:
		hand_pos = rope_points[last_idx]
		current_stretch_ratio = 0.0
	else:
		var total_len: float = get_total_rope_length()
		current_stretch_ratio = clampf((total_len - max_length) / stretch_limit, 0.0, 1.0)

	wire.width = lerpf(12.0, 7.5, current_stretch_ratio)
	shadow.width = lerpf(16.0, 10.5, current_stretch_ratio)

	var packed: PackedVector2Array = PackedVector2Array(rope_points)
	wire.points = packed
	shadow.points = packed

func _solve_collisions(space_state: PhysicsDirectSpaceState2D, end_locked: bool) -> void:
	var last_idx: int = rope_segments
	var max_point_idx: int = last_idx if end_locked else last_idx + 1

	for i in range(1, max_point_idx):
		shape_query.transform = Transform2D(0.0, rope_points[i])
		var contacts: Array[Vector2] = space_state.collide_shape(shape_query, 4)
		if not contacts.is_empty():
			var push: Vector2 = Vector2.ZERO
			var count: float = 0.0
			for c in range(0, contacts.size(), 2):
				push += (contacts[c + 1] - contacts[c])
				count += 1.0
			if count > 0.0:
				var displacement: Vector2 = push / count
				rope_points[i] += displacement
				old_rope_points[i] = old_rope_points[i].lerp(rope_points[i], 0.6)

	for i in range(1, last_idx - 1):
		var mid: Vector2 = (rope_points[i] + rope_points[i + 1]) * 0.5
		shape_query.transform = Transform2D(0.0, mid)
		var contacts: Array[Vector2] = space_state.collide_shape(shape_query, 2)
		if not contacts.is_empty():
			var push: Vector2 = contacts[1] - contacts[0]
			rope_points[i] += push * 0.5
			rope_points[i + 1] += push * 0.5
			old_rope_points[i] = old_rope_points[i].lerp(rope_points[i], 0.5)
			old_rope_points[i + 1] = old_rope_points[i + 1].lerp(rope_points[i + 1], 0.5)

func _draw() -> void:
	if rope_points.size() < 2:
		return

	var end_pt: Vector2 = rope_points[rope_segments]
	var prev_pt: Vector2 = rope_points[rope_segments - 1]
	var dir: Vector2 = end_pt - prev_pt
	var angle: float = dir.angle() if dir.length_squared() > 0.01 else 0.0

	var shadow_offset: Vector2 = Vector2(4, 6).rotated(-angle)
	draw_set_transform(end_pt, angle, Vector2.ONE)

	draw_style_box(plug_shadow_style, Rect2(Vector2(-10, -8) + shadow_offset, Vector2(20, 16)))

	if not is_plugged:
		var prong_col: Color = Color(0.78, 0.82, 0.86)
		draw_rect(Rect2(8, -5, 6, 3), prong_col)
		draw_circle(Vector2(14, -3.5), 1.5, prong_col)
		draw_rect(Rect2(8, 2, 6, 3), prong_col)
		draw_circle(Vector2(14, 3.5), 1.5, prong_col)

	draw_style_box(plug_boot_style, Rect2(-14, -5, 7, 10))
	draw_style_box(plug_body_style, Rect2(-9, -8, 18, 16))
	draw_line(Vector2(-3, -4), Vector2(-3, 4), wire_color, 3.0, true)
	draw_set_transform(Vector2.ZERO, 0.0, Vector2.ONE)

@tool
extends StaticBody2D
class_name WirePort

signal rotated(new_side: int)

@export var rotatable: bool = true
@export var click_radius: float = 14.0
@export var reach: float = 300.0
@export var edge_margin: float = 0.0

const DIRS := [Vector2.RIGHT, Vector2.DOWN, Vector2.LEFT, Vector2.UP]

static var _hover_count: int = 0

var side: int = 0
var hovered: bool = false
var flash: float = 0.0
var pulse_time: float = 0.0

var _center := Vector2.ZERO
var _half := Vector2(64, 64)
var _rot_target: float = 0.0
var _tween: Tween

func _ready() -> void:
	_rot_target = rotation
	side = posmod(roundi(rotation / (PI * 0.5)), 4)
	_measure()
	if Engine.is_editor_hint():
		return
	var p := get_parent()
	if p != null and p.has_meta("is_ghost"):
		material = ModuleArt.make_ghost_material()
		rotatable = false

func _exit_tree() -> void:
	if hovered:
		hovered = false
		_hover_count = maxi(0, _hover_count - 1)
		if _hover_count == 0:
			Input.set_default_cursor_shape(Input.CURSOR_ARROW)

func _measure() -> void:
	var p := get_parent()
	if p == null:
		return
	for n in p.get_children():
		if n is CollisionShape2D and (n as CollisionShape2D).shape is RectangleShape2D:
			var cs := n as CollisionShape2D
			_half = (cs.shape as RectangleShape2D).size * 0.5
			_center = cs.position
			return

func _interactive() -> bool:
	if not rotatable:
		return false
	var p := get_parent()
	if p == null:
		return false
	if p is BaseModule and (p as BaseModule).is_constructing:
		return false
	var pl := get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("player") as Node2D
	if pl == null or not pl.visible:
		return false
	if pl.get("is_build_mode") == true:
		return false
	return pl.global_position.distance_to(global_position) <= reach

func _mouse_hit() -> bool:
	var rad := maxf(click_radius * absf(global_scale.x), 24.0)
	return get_global_mouse_position().distance_to(global_position) <= rad

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	pulse_time += delta
	flash = maxf(0.0, flash - delta * 2.2)
	if not Engine.is_editor_hint():
		var h := _interactive() and _mouse_hit()
		if h != hovered:
			hovered = h
			if hovered:
				_hover_count += 1
			else:
				_hover_count = maxi(0, _hover_count - 1)
			Input.set_default_cursor_shape(Input.CURSOR_POINTING_HAND if _hover_count > 0 else Input.CURSOR_ARROW)
	queue_redraw()

func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if Engine.is_editor_hint() or not hovered:
		return
	if event is InputEventMouseButton and event.pressed:
		if event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
			rotate_side(1)
			get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
		elif event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_RIGHT:
			rotate_side(-1)
			get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()

func rotate_side(step: int) -> void:
	side = posmod(side + step, 4)
	var d: Vector2 = DIRS[side]
	var edge := _half.x if d.x != 0.0 else _half.y
	var target := _center + d * (edge + edge_margin)
	_rot_target += float(step) * PI * 0.5
	if _tween != null and _tween.is_valid():
		_tween.kill()
	_tween = create_tween().set_parallel(true)
	_tween.tween_property(self, "position", target, 0.3).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_BACK).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	_tween.tween_property(self, "rotation", _rot_target, 0.3).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_BACK).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	flash = 1.0
	rotated.emit(side)

func _arrow_arc(rad: float, a0: float, col: Color, w: float) -> void:
	var a1 := a0 + 1.1
	draw_arc(Vector2.ZERO, rad, a0, a1, 14, col, w, true)
	var tip := Vector2.from_angle(a1) * rad
	var tg := Vector2.from_angle(a1 + PI * 0.5)
	var rv := Vector2.from_angle(a1)
	var hs := rad * 0.3
	draw_colored_polygon(PackedVector2Array([tip + tg * hs * 1.2, tip + rv * hs * 0.7 - tg * hs * 0.2, tip - rv * hs * 0.7 - tg * hs * 0.2]), col)

func _draw_port_fx(rad: float) -> void:
	if not hovered and flash <= 0.01:
		return
	var a := 1.0 if hovered else flash
	var pulse := 0.65 + 0.35 * sin(pulse_time * 9.0)
	var w := rad * 0.07
	var col := Color(0.4, 1.3, 1.6, a * pulse)
	draw_arc(Vector2.ZERO, rad, 0.0, TAU, 40, Color(col.r, col.g, col.b, a * 0.35), w, true)
	_arrow_arc(rad * 1.3, pulse_time * 2.5, col, w * 1.5)
	_arrow_arc(rad * 1.3, pulse_time * 2.5 + PI, col, w * 1.5)
	if flash > 0.01:
		draw_arc(Vector2.ZERO, rad * (1.0 + (1.0 - flash) * 1.4), 0.0, TAU, 40, Color(1.2, 1.6, 1.8, flash * 0.8), w * 2.0, true)

@tool
extends WirePort
class_name WireReceiver

@export var standby_color: Color = Color(0.25, 0.75, 1.0):
	set(value):
		standby_color = value
		queue_redraw()

var receiver_point: Marker2D = null
var target_module: BaseModule = null
var connected_wire: Node2D = null

var housing_style: StyleBoxFlat
var well_style: StyleBoxFlat
var flange_style: StyleBoxFlat

func _ready() -> void:
	super._ready()
	var old_sprite: Sprite2D = get_node_or_null("Sprite2D") as Sprite2D
	if old_sprite != null:
		old_sprite.visible = false

	receiver_point = get_node_or_null("ReceiverPoint") as Marker2D
	if receiver_point == null:
		receiver_point = get_node_or_null("RecieverPoint") as Marker2D

	_init_styles()
	queue_redraw()

	if not Engine.is_editor_hint():
		add_to_group("wire_receivers")
		if get_parent() is BaseModule:
			target_module = get_parent() as BaseModule

func _init_styles() -> void:
	housing_style = StyleBoxFlat.new()
	housing_style.bg_color = Color(0.17, 0.19, 0.23)
	housing_style.border_color = Color(0.07, 0.08, 0.10)
	housing_style.set_border_width_all(2)
	housing_style.set_corner_radius_all(5)

	well_style = StyleBoxFlat.new()
	well_style.bg_color = Color(0.08, 0.09, 0.12)
	well_style.border_color = Color(0.25, 0.28, 0.33)
	well_style.set_border_width_all(1)
	well_style.set_corner_radius_all(3)

	flange_style = StyleBoxFlat.new()
	flange_style.bg_color = Color(0.24, 0.27, 0.32)
	flange_style.border_color = Color(0.09, 0.10, 0.12)
	flange_style.set_border_width_all(1)
	flange_style.set_corner_radius_all(2)

func get_receiver_position() -> Vector2:
	if receiver_point != null:
		return receiver_point.global_position
	return global_position

func can_accept_wire() -> bool:
	if connected_wire != null and is_instance_valid(connected_wire):
		return false
	if target_module == null and get_parent() is BaseModule:
		target_module = get_parent() as BaseModule
	if target_module == null:
		return false
	return target_module.can_accept_wires and not target_module.is_broken

func accept_wire(wire_node: Node2D) -> void:
	if target_module == null and get_parent() is BaseModule:
		target_module = get_parent() as BaseModule
	connected_wire = wire_node
	if target_module != null:
		target_module.accept_wire(wire_node)
	queue_redraw()

func remove_wire(wire_node: Node2D) -> void:
	if connected_wire == wire_node:
		connected_wire = null
	if target_module != null:
		target_module.remove_wire(wire_node)
	queue_redraw()

func _get_active_color() -> Color:
	if connected_wire != null and is_instance_valid(connected_wire) and "wire_color" in connected_wire:
		return connected_wire.wire_color
	if target_module != null and target_module.is_broken:
		return Color(1.0, 0.15, 0.15)
	return standby_color

func _draw() -> void:
	if housing_style == null:
		_init_styles()

	var is_plugged_in: bool = connected_wire != null and is_instance_valid(connected_wire)
	var active_col: Color = _get_active_color()
	var pulse: float = 0.7 + 0.3 * sin(pulse_time * (6.0 if is_plugged_in else 3.0))

	draw_rect(Rect2(-14, -30, 32, 64), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.42))
	draw_style_box(flange_style, Rect2(-18, -26, 8, 52))
	draw_style_box(housing_style, Rect2(-14, -32, 30, 64))
	draw_style_box(well_style, Rect2(-8, -22, 20, 44))

	var bolt_col: Color = Color(0.40, 0.44, 0.50)
	draw_circle(Vector2(-10, -27), 1.8, bolt_col)
	draw_circle(Vector2(11, -27), 1.8, bolt_col)
	draw_circle(Vector2(-10, 27), 1.8, bolt_col)
	draw_circle(Vector2(11, 27), 1.8, bolt_col)

	var rail_col: Color = active_col if is_plugged_in else active_col.darkened(0.45)
	rail_col.a = 0.95 if is_plugged_in else 0.55 * pulse
	draw_line(Vector2(-4, -25), Vector2(10, -25), rail_col, 2.5)
	draw_line(Vector2(-4, 25), Vector2(10, 25), rail_col, 2.5)
	draw_line(Vector2(-11, -16), Vector2(-11, 16), rail_col, 2.0)

	var sock_pos: Vector2 = Vector2(6, 0)
	if receiver_point != null:
		sock_pos = receiver_point.position - Vector2(6, 0)

	if is_plugged_in:
		var glow: Color = active_col.lightened(0.25)
		glow.a = 0.35 * pulse
		draw_circle(sock_pos, 12.0, glow)

	draw_circle(sock_pos, 9.0, Color(0.14, 0.16, 0.20))
	draw_arc(sock_pos, 9.0, 0.0, TAU, 24, rail_col, 2.0, true)

	var slot_col: Color = active_col.lightened(0.2) if is_plugged_in else Color(0.03, 0.04, 0.05)
	draw_rect(Rect2(sock_pos + Vector2(-3, -6), Vector2(6, 3.5)), slot_col)
	draw_rect(Rect2(sock_pos + Vector2(-3, 2.5), Vector2(6, 3.5)), slot_col)

	var led_top_col: Color = active_col.lightened(0.25) if is_plugged_in else Color(0.18, 0.20, 0.24)
	draw_circle(Vector2(0, -15), 2.2, led_top_col)
	draw_circle(Vector2(0, 15), 2.2, led_top_col)

	_draw_port_fx(40.0)

extends StaticBody2D
class_name BaseModule

@export var module_name: String = "Module"
@export var mass_cost: float = 1000.0
@export var power_draw: float = 30.0
@export var can_accept_wires: bool = true
@export var build_time: float = 10.0
@export var fix_time: float = 4.0
@export var proximity_distance: float = 120.0

var is_powered: bool = false
var is_broken: bool = false
var is_constructing: bool = false
var build_progress: float = 0.0
var fix_progress: float = 0.0
var connected_wires: Array = []
var base_visual_color: Color = Color.WHITE
var flash_time: float = 0.0

var progress_bar: ProgressBar = null
var visual_rect: ColorRect = null

func _ready() -> void:
	visual_rect = get_node_or_null("Visual")
	if visual_rect != null:
		base_visual_color = visual_rect.color
		visual_rect.visible = false
	var old_sprite := get_node_or_null("Sprite2D") as CanvasItem
	if old_sprite != null:
		old_sprite.visible = false
	var art := ModuleArt.new()
	art.name = "ModuleArt"
	add_child(art)
	move_child(art, 0)
 
	if not is_constructing:
		if get_node_or_null("/root/BaseManager") != null:
			if not BaseManager.active_modules.has(self):
				BaseManager.active_modules.append(self)
			BaseManager.calculate_power()

func start_construction() -> void:
	is_constructing = true
	build_progress = 0.0
	can_accept_wires = false
	
	modulate.a = 0.5
	
	progress_bar = ProgressBar.new()
	progress_bar.max_value = 100.0
	progress_bar.value = 0.0
	progress_bar.size = Vector2(100, 20)
	progress_bar.position = Vector2(-50, -40)
	progress_bar.show_percentage = false
	progress_bar.modulate = Color.GREEN
	add_child(progress_bar)

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	var player = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("player")
	if not is_instance_valid(player):
		return
		
	var dist = global_position.distance_to(player.global_position)
	
	if is_constructing:
		if dist <= proximity_distance:
			build_progress += (100.0 / build_time) * delta
			progress_bar.value = build_progress
			progress_bar.modulate = Color.GREEN
			if build_progress >= 100.0:
				_finish_build()
		else:
			progress_bar.modulate = Color.RED
			
	elif is_broken:
		if Input.is_action_pressed("interact") and dist <= proximity_distance:
			fix_progress += (100.0 / fix_time) * delta
			progress_bar.value = fix_progress
			progress_bar.modulate = Color.ORANGE
			if fix_progress >= 100.0:
				_finish_fix()
		else:
			if fix_progress > 0.0:
				fix_progress = 0.0
				progress_bar.value = 0

func _finish_build() -> void:
	is_constructing = false
	can_accept_wires = true
	modulate.a = 1.0
	
	if progress_bar != null:
		progress_bar.queue_free()
		progress_bar = null
		
	if get_node_or_null("/root/BaseManager") != null:
		if not BaseManager.active_modules.has(self):
			BaseManager.active_modules.append(self)
		BaseManager.calculate_power()

func break_module() -> void:
	if is_constructing or is_broken: return
	if module_name == "Reactor": return
	
	is_broken = true
	is_powered = false
	fix_progress = 0.0
	
	if progress_bar == null:
		progress_bar = ProgressBar.new()
		progress_bar.max_value = 100.0
		progress_bar.size = Vector2(100, 20)
		progress_bar.position = Vector2(-50, -40)
		progress_bar.show_percentage = false
		add_child(progress_bar)
		
	progress_bar.visible = true
	progress_bar.value = 0
	progress_bar.modulate = Color.RED
	
	var wires_to_drop: Array = connected_wires.duplicate()
	connected_wires.clear()
	for w in wires_to_drop:
		if is_instance_valid(w):
			if is_instance_valid(w.plugged_receiver) and w.plugged_receiver.has_method("remove_wire"):
				w.plugged_receiver.remove_wire(w)
			if w.has_method("drop"):
				w.drop(w.hand_pos)
				
	if get_node_or_null("/root/BaseManager") != null:
		BaseManager.calculate_power()
	if get_node_or_null("/root/EventBus") != null:
		EventBus.module_broken.emit(module_name)

func _finish_fix() -> void:
	is_broken = false
	fix_progress = 0.0
	
	if progress_bar != null:
		progress_bar.visible = false
		
	if get_node_or_null("/root/BaseManager") != null:
		BaseManager.calculate_power()

func has_valid_power_source() -> bool:
	if module_name == "Reactor":
		return not is_broken
	if is_broken or is_constructing:
		return false
	for w in connected_wires:
		if is_instance_valid(w) and "source_module" in w and is_instance_valid(w.source_module):
			var src: BaseModule = w.source_module
			if src.module_name == "Reactor" and not src.is_broken and BaseManager.reactor_energy > 0.0:
				return true
	return false

func accept_wire(wire_node: Node2D) -> void:
	if not can_accept_wires or is_broken or is_constructing:
		return
	if not connected_wires.has(wire_node):
		connected_wires.append(wire_node)
	if get_node_or_null("/root/BaseManager") != null:
		BaseManager.calculate_power()

func remove_wire(wire_node: Node2D) -> void:
	connected_wires.erase(wire_node)
	if connected_wires.is_empty():
		is_powered = false
	if get_node_or_null("/root/BaseManager") != null:
		BaseManager.calculate_power()

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if is_constructing: return
	if visual_rect == null: return
	
	flash_time += delta
	
	if is_broken:
		var pulse: float = 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(flash_time * 10.0)
		visual_rect.color = base_visual_color.darkened(0.65).lerp(Color(1.0, 0.1, 0.1), pulse)
	elif is_powered or module_name == "Reactor":
		var glow: float = 0.06 * sin(flash_time * 4.0)
		visual_rect.color = base_visual_color.lightened(glow)
	else:
		visual_rect.color = base_visual_color.darkened(0.55)
