extends Node2D
class_name ModuleArt

const GHOST_CODE := """shader_type canvas_item;
uniform vec4 tint : source_color = vec4(0.35, 0.85, 1.3, 1.0);
varying vec2 wpos;
void vertex() {
	wpos = (MODEL_MATRIX * vec4(VERTEX, 0.0, 1.0)).xy;
}
void fragment() {
	float l = dot(COLOR.rgb, vec3(0.299, 0.587, 0.114));
	float lines = 0.7 + 0.3 * step(0.5, fract(wpos.y * 0.3));
	float sweep = pow(max(0.0, sin(wpos.y * 0.045 - TIME * 2.6)), 20.0);
	vec3 c = tint.rgb * (0.25 + l * 1.15) * lines + tint.rgb * sweep * 0.7;
	COLOR = vec4(c, COLOR.a * 0.92);
}
"""

static var _ghost_shader: Shader

var host: BaseModule
var kind: String = ""
var rect := Rect2(0, 0, 256, 256)
var ghost := false
var t := 0.0
var spin := 0.0
var flow := 0.0
var slow := 0.0
var power_k := 0.0
var broken_k := 0.0
var build_k := 1.0
var box := StyleBoxFlat.new()
var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
var _blocked := false
var _synced := false
var _phase := 0.0

static func make_ghost_material() -> ShaderMaterial:
	if _ghost_shader == null:
		_ghost_shader = Shader.new()
		_ghost_shader.code = GHOST_CODE
	var m := ShaderMaterial.new()
	m.shader = _ghost_shader
	return m

func _ready() -> void:
	host = get_parent() as BaseModule
	if host == null:
		set_process(false)
		return
	kind = host.module_name
	ghost = host.has_meta("is_ghost")
	_phase = randf() * 10.0
	t = _phase
	box.anti_aliasing = true
	var col := host.get_node_or_null("CollisionShape2D") as CollisionShape2D
	if col != null and col.shape is RectangleShape2D:
		var sz: Vector2 = (col.shape as RectangleShape2D).size
		rect = Rect2(col.position - sz * 0.5, sz)
	if ghost:
		process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
		power_k = 1.0
		material = make_ghost_material()
		_sync_ghost()

func _is_active() -> bool:
	if ghost:
		return true
	if host.is_broken or host.is_constructing:
		return false
	if kind == "Solar Panel":
		return true
	if kind == "Reactor":
		return BaseManager.reactor_energy > 0.0
	return host.is_powered

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if host == null:
		return
	t += delta
	var target := 1.0 if _is_active() else 0.0
	power_k = lerpf(power_k, target, 1.0 - exp(-5.0 * delta))
	broken_k = lerpf(broken_k, 1.0 if host.is_broken else 0.0, 1.0 - exp(-8.0 * delta))
	build_k = clampf(host.build_progress / 100.0, 0.0, 1.0) if host.is_constructing else 1.0
	spin += delta * 9.0 * power_k
	flow += delta * 70.0 * power_k
	slow += delta * (0.35 + 0.9 * power_k)
	if ghost:
		_sync_ghost()
	queue_redraw()

func _sync_ghost() -> void:
	var m := host.modulate
	var blocked := m.r > m.b * 1.4
	if _synced and blocked == _blocked:
		return
	_synced = true
	_blocked = blocked
	var tint := Color(1.8, 0.35, 0.3) if blocked else Color(0.35, 0.85, 1.3)
	(material as ShaderMaterial).set_shader_parameter("tint", tint)
	for ch in host.get_children():
		if ch is CanvasItem and (ch as CanvasItem).material is ShaderMaterial:
			((ch as CanvasItem).material as ShaderMaterial).set_shader_parameter("tint", tint)

func _col(c: Color, k: float, a: float = 1.0) -> Color:
	return Color(c.r * k, c.g * k, c.b * k, a)

func _rbox(r: Rect2, fill: Color, border: Color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0), radius: int = 6, bw: int = 0) -> void:
	box.bg_color = fill
	box.border_color = border
	box.set_border_width_all(bw)
	box.set_corner_radius_all(radius)
	draw_style_box(box, r)

func _glow(p: Vector2, rad: float, col: Color, a: float) -> void:
	for i in 5:
		var k := float(i) / 4.0
		draw_circle(p, rad * (1.0 + k * 1.3), Color(col.r, col.g, col.b, a * (1.0 - k) * 0.28))

func _disc(p: Vector2, rad: float, fill: Color, rim: Color, w: float) -> void:
	draw_circle(p, rad, fill)
	draw_arc(p, rad, 0.0, TAU, 48, rim, w, true)

func _led(p: Vector2, col: Color, on: float) -> void:
	var lit := on * (0.65 + 0.35 * sin(t * 5.0 + p.x))
	draw_circle(p, 3.6, Color(0.04, 0.05, 0.07))
	draw_circle(p, 2.5, col.darkened(0.75).lerp(_col(col, 1.3), lit))
	if lit > 0.3:
		_glow(p, 3.0, col, lit)

func _bolts(r: Rect2, inset: float) -> void:
	for i in 4:
		var p := Vector2(r.position.x + inset if i % 2 == 0 else r.end.x - inset, r.position.y + inset if i < 2 else r.end.y - inset)
		draw_circle(p, 3.4, Color(0.3, 0.34, 0.4))
		draw_circle(p, 1.6, Color(0.1, 0.11, 0.14))

func _brackets(r: Rect2, col: Color, ln: float, w: float) -> void:
	var corners: Array[Vector2] = [r.position, Vector2(r.end.x, r.position.y), r.end, Vector2(r.position.x, r.end.y)]
	var sx: Array[float] = [1.0, -1.0, -1.0, 1.0]
	var sy: Array[float] = [1.0, 1.0, -1.0, -1.0]
	for i in 4:
		var p: Vector2 = corners[i]
		draw_line(p, p + Vector2(ln * sx[i], 0.0), col, w)
		draw_line(p, p + Vector2(0.0, ln * sy[i]), col, w)

func _hex(c: Vector2, rad: float, rot: float = 0.0) -> PackedVector2Array:
	var pts := PackedVector2Array()
	for i in 6:
		pts.append(c + Vector2.from_angle(rot + i * PI / 3.0) * rad)
	return pts

func _loop(pts: PackedVector2Array) -> PackedVector2Array:
	var out := pts.duplicate()
	out.append(pts[0])
	return out

func _path_len(pts: PackedVector2Array) -> float:
	var total := 0.0
	for i in pts.size() - 1:
		total += pts[i].distance_to(pts[i + 1])
	return total

func _path_point(pts: PackedVector2Array, s: float) -> Vector2:
	var rem := s
	for i in pts.size() - 1:
		var seg := pts[i].distance_to(pts[i + 1])
		if rem <= seg:
			return pts[i].lerp(pts[i + 1], rem / maxf(seg, 0.001))
		rem -= seg
	return pts[pts.size() - 1]

func _draw() -> void:
	if host == null:
		return
	if not ghost:
		_rbox(Rect2(rect.position + Vector2(6, 10), rect.size), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.35), Color(0, 0, 0, 0), 12, 0)
	match kind:
		"Solar Panel":
			_draw_solar()
		"Reactor":
			_draw_reactor()
		"Life Support":
			_draw_life()
		"Thermal Control":
			_draw_thermal()
		"Shield":
			_draw_shield()
		"Comms":
			_draw_comms()
		_:
			_rbox(rect, Color(0.2, 0.22, 0.28), Color(0.6, 0.65, 0.75), 8, 3)
	if ghost:
		_draw_blueprint()
	elif host.is_constructing:
		_draw_scaffold()
	else:
		_draw_state()

func _draw_solar() -> void:
	var r := rect
	var c := r.get_center()
	var on := power_k
	var gold := Color(1.0, 0.8, 0.25)
	_rbox(r, Color(0.17, 0.19, 0.24), Color(0.62, 0.68, 0.78), 8, 3)
	var inner := Rect2(r.position + Vector2(12, 12), Vector2(r.size.x - 50.0, r.size.y - 24.0))
	_rbox(inner, Color(0.04, 0.06, 0.1), Color(0.02, 0.03, 0.05), 4, 2)
	var cols := 4
	var rows := 3
	var gap := 4.0
	var cw := (inner.size.x - gap * (cols + 1)) / cols
	var ch := (inner.size.y - gap * (rows + 1)) / rows
	for j in rows:
		for i in cols:
			var cr := Rect2(inner.position + Vector2(gap + i * (cw + gap), gap + j * (ch + gap)), Vector2(cw, ch))
			var wave := 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(t * 2.4 - float(i + j) * 0.8)
			var glow := on * wave
			_rbox(cr, Color(0.05, 0.1, 0.24).lerp(Color(0.1, 0.32, 0.66), glow), Color(0.5, 0.68, 0.95, 0.55), 2, 1)
			for k in range(1, 4):
				var x := cr.position.x + cw * k / 4.0
				draw_line(Vector2(x, cr.position.y + 1.0), Vector2(x, cr.end.y - 1.0), Color(0.45, 0.65, 1.0, 0.28), 1.0)
			for k in range(1, 3):
				var y := cr.position.y + ch * k / 3.0
				draw_line(Vector2(cr.position.x + 1.0, y), Vector2(cr.end.x - 1.0, y), Color(0.45, 0.65, 1.0, 0.28), 1.0)
			draw_rect(cr, Color(1.0, 0.92, 0.6, glow * 0.16))
			draw_line(cr.position + Vector2(cw * 0.2, ch * 0.9), cr.position + Vector2(cw * 0.8, ch * 0.1), Color(1, 1, 1, glow * 0.4), 1.5, true)
	var jb := Rect2(r.end.x - 34.0, c.y - 36.0, 34.0, 72.0)
	_rbox(jb, Color(0.22, 0.24, 0.3), Color(0.7, 0.74, 0.82), 4, 2)
	_rbox(jb.grow(-6.0), Color(0.07, 0.08, 0.11), Color(0, 0, 0, 0), 3, 0)
	for k in 3:
		_led(Vector2(jb.position.x + 17.0, jb.position.y + 18.0 + k * 18.0), gold if k != 1 else Color(0.3, 1.0, 0.5), on)
	draw_line(Vector2(jb.end.x - 6.0, c.y), Vector2(r.end.x + 4.0, c.y), _col(gold, 0.4 + 1.2 * on, 0.4 + 0.6 * on), 4.0, true)
	_bolts(r, 6.0)

func _draw_reactor() -> void:
	var r := rect
	var c := r.get_center()
	var energy := clampf(BaseManager.reactor_energy / 100.0, 0.0, 1.0)
	var on := power_k
	var cyan := Color(0.2, 0.95, 1.0)
	var core_col := cyan.lerp(Color(1.0, 0.3, 0.15), 1.0 - energy)
	_rbox(r, Color(0.1, 0.13, 0.17), Color(0.2, 0.75, 0.9), 14, 3)
	_rbox(r.grow(-8.0), Color(0.05, 0.07, 0.1), Color(0.14, 0.26, 0.32), 10, 1)
	for si in 2:
		var s := -1.0 if si == 0 else 1.0
		for i in 3:
			var x := c.x + s * (70.0 + i * 16.0)
			var h := 64.0
			_rbox(Rect2(x - 5.0, c.y - h * 0.5, 10.0, h), Color(0.08, 0.12, 0.16), Color(0.2, 0.3, 0.36), 3, 1)
			var fill := clampf(energy * on * (0.65 + 0.35 * sin(t * 3.0 - i * 0.8 + s)), 0.0, 1.0)
			var fh := maxf((h - 6.0) * fill, 1.0)
			_rbox(Rect2(x - 3.0, c.y + h * 0.5 - 3.0 - fh, 6.0, fh), _col(core_col, 0.5 + 0.8 * on), Color(0, 0, 0, 0), 2, 0)
		_rbox(Rect2(c.x + s * 120.0 - 6.0, c.y - 26.0, 12.0, 52.0), Color(0.03, 0.04, 0.06), Color(0.25, 0.4, 0.48), 3, 1)
	_disc(c, 47.0, Color(0.05, 0.07, 0.1), Color(0.35, 0.42, 0.5), 3.0)
	_disc(c, 39.0, Color(0.08, 0.11, 0.15), Color(0.2, 0.25, 0.3), 2.0)
	if on > 0.01:
		_glow(c, 26.0, core_col, on)
	for i in 3:
		var a := slow * (1.6 + 0.3 * i) + i * TAU / 3.0
		draw_arc(c, 33.0 - i * 5.0, a, a + 1.7, 18, Color(core_col.r, core_col.g, core_col.b, 0.25 + 0.65 * on), 3.0, true)
	var pulse := 1.0 + 0.12 * sin(t * 6.0)
	draw_circle(c, 16.0 * pulse * (0.45 + 0.55 * on), _col(core_col, 0.35 + 1.3 * on))
	draw_circle(c, 7.0, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.35 + 0.65 * on))
	draw_arc(c, 52.0, 0.0, TAU, 64, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.08), 4.0, true)
	if energy > 0.01:
		draw_arc(c, 52.0, -PI * 0.5, -PI * 0.5 + TAU * energy, 64, _col(core_col, 1.2), 4.0, true)

func _draw_life() -> void:
	var r := rect
	var c := r.get_center()
	var on := power_k
	var teal := Color(0.2, 0.95, 0.8)
	_rbox(r, Color(0.09, 0.15, 0.17), Color(0.25, 0.8, 0.75), 12, 3)
	_rbox(r.grow(-10.0), Color(0.06, 0.1, 0.12), Color(0.12, 0.3, 0.32), 8, 1)
	_bolts(r, 10.0)
	var tpos: Array[Vector2] = [Vector2(c.x - 58.0, c.y - 62.0), Vector2(c.x + 58.0, c.y - 62.0)]
	var pipe_y := c.y + 8.0
	draw_line(Vector2(tpos[0].x, tpos[0].y + 30.0), Vector2(tpos[0].x, pipe_y), Color(0.3, 0.38, 0.42), 11.0)
	draw_line(Vector2(tpos[1].x, tpos[1].y + 30.0), Vector2(tpos[1].x, pipe_y), Color(0.3, 0.38, 0.42), 11.0)
	draw_line(Vector2(tpos[0].x, pipe_y), Vector2(tpos[1].x, pipe_y), Color(0.3, 0.38, 0.42), 11.0)
	draw_line(Vector2(c.x, pipe_y), Vector2(c.x, c.y + 24.0), Color(0.3, 0.38, 0.42), 11.0)
	draw_line(Vector2(tpos[0].x + 2.0, pipe_y - 2.0), Vector2(tpos[1].x - 2.0, pipe_y - 2.0), _col(teal, 0.3 + 0.7 * on, 0.6), 2.0)
	for ti in 2:
		var tp: Vector2 = tpos[ti]
		_disc(tp, 44.0, Color(0.1, 0.18, 0.2), Color(0.35, 0.55, 0.6), 3.0)
		_disc(tp, 36.0, Color(0.06, 0.14, 0.16), Color(0.15, 0.4, 0.42), 2.0)
		var lvl := 0.3 + 0.7 * on
		draw_circle(tp, 29.0, Color(0.05 + 0.1 * lvl, 0.2 + 0.5 * lvl, 0.2 + 0.45 * lvl, 0.95))
		if on > 0.05:
			_glow(tp, 20.0, teal, on * 0.7)
			for b in 5:
				var ph := fposmod(t * 0.45 + b * 0.2 + ti * 0.37, 1.0)
				var bp := tp + Vector2(sin(ph * 9.0 + b) * 10.0, 22.0 - ph * 46.0)
				draw_circle(bp, 2.0 + float(b % 3) * 0.7, Color(0.8, 1.0, 1.0, (1.0 - ph) * 0.7 * on))
		draw_arc(tp, 22.0, PI * 1.1, PI * 1.7, 12, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.35), 3.0, true)
		for k in 12:
			var a := k * TAU / 12.0
			draw_line(tp + Vector2.from_angle(a) * 38.0, tp + Vector2.from_angle(a) * 42.0, Color(0.5, 0.75, 0.8, 0.7), 2.0)
	var fc := Vector2(c.x, c.y + 72.0)
	_disc(fc, 50.0, Color(0.08, 0.12, 0.14), Color(0.4, 0.6, 0.65), 3.0)
	draw_circle(fc, 45.0, Color(teal.r, teal.g, teal.b, 0.1 * on))
	for b in 5:
		var a := spin + b * TAU / 5.0
		var blade := PackedVector2Array([
			fc + Vector2.from_angle(a) * 8.0,
			fc + Vector2.from_angle(a - 0.18) * 43.0,
			fc + Vector2.from_angle(a + 0.5) * 41.0,
			fc + Vector2.from_angle(a + 0.55) * 10.0])
		draw_colored_polygon(blade, Color(0.35, 0.6, 0.62).lerp(teal, on * 0.5))
	_disc(fc, 9.0, Color(0.15, 0.2, 0.22), _col(teal, 0.5 + 0.8 * on), 2.0)
	for si in 2:
		var s := -1.0 if si == 0 else 1.0
		for k in 5:
			var vx := c.x + s * (72.0 + k * 8.0)
			draw_line(Vector2(vx, c.y + 56.0), Vector2(vx, c.y + 100.0), Color(0.03, 0.06, 0.07), 3.0)

func _draw_thermal() -> void:
	var r := rect
	var on := power_k
	var hot := Color(1.0, 0.45, 0.12)
	_rbox(r, Color(0.16, 0.1, 0.08), Color(0.9, 0.4, 0.15), 10, 3)
	_rbox(r.grow(-8.0), Color(0.1, 0.07, 0.06), Color(0.3, 0.15, 0.1), 6, 1)
	for si in 2:
		var fx := r.position.x + 14.0 if si == 0 else r.end.x - 36.0
		for i in 8:
			var fy := r.position.y + 16.0 + i * 20.5
			var heat := on * (0.5 + 0.5 * sin(t * 3.0 - i * 0.6 + si * PI))
			_rbox(Rect2(fx, fy, 22.0, 12.0), Color(0.28, 0.22, 0.2).lerp(hot, heat * 0.85), Color(0.08, 0.06, 0.05), 2, 1)
	var br := Rect2(r.position + Vector2(44, 16), Vector2(r.size.x - 88.0, r.size.y - 32.0))
	_rbox(br, Color(0.07, 0.05, 0.05), Color(0.5, 0.25, 0.12), 6, 2)
	var pts := PackedVector2Array()
	var rows := 6
	for i in rows:
		var y := br.position.y + 18.0 + i * ((br.size.y - 36.0) / (rows - 1))
		var lx := br.position.x + 14.0
		var rx := br.end.x - 14.0
		if i % 2 == 0:
			pts.append(Vector2(lx, y))
			pts.append(Vector2(rx, y))
		else:
			pts.append(Vector2(rx, y))
			pts.append(Vector2(lx, y))
	draw_polyline(pts, Color(0.22, 0.13, 0.1), 9.0, true)
	draw_polyline(pts, _col(hot, 0.3 + 1.1 * on), 5.0, true)
	if on > 0.05:
		var total := _path_len(pts)
		for k in 6:
			var p := _path_point(pts, fposmod(flow + k * total / 6.0, total))
			_glow(p, 3.5, Color(1.0, 0.8, 0.4), on * 0.8)
			draw_circle(p, 3.0, Color(1.6, 1.3, 0.8, on))
	var gauge := clampf(BaseManager.temp_level / 100.0, 0.0, 1.0)
	var gc := Vector2(br.get_center().x, br.position.y - 1.0)
	draw_arc(gc, 9.0, 0.0, PI, 12, Color(0.2, 0.2, 0.25), 3.0, true)
	draw_arc(gc, 9.0, PI, PI + PI * gauge, 12, Color(0.4, 0.9, 1.0).lerp(hot, 1.0 - gauge), 3.0, true)

func _draw_shield() -> void:
	var r := rect
	var c := r.get_center()
	var on := power_k
	var vio := Color(0.65, 0.4, 1.0)
	_rbox(r, Color(0.1, 0.08, 0.16), Color(0.55, 0.35, 0.95), 12, 3)
	_rbox(r.grow(-8.0), Color(0.07, 0.05, 0.11), Color(0.25, 0.15, 0.4), 8, 1)
	_bolts(r, 11.0)
	var hr := 70.0
	var hp := _hex(c, hr)
	draw_colored_polygon(hp, Color(0.05, 0.04, 0.09))
	draw_polyline(_loop(hp), _col(vio, 0.5 + 0.8 * on), 3.0, true)
	for i in 7:
		var off := Vector2.ZERO if i == 0 else Vector2.from_angle(PI / 6.0 + (i - 1) * PI / 3.0) * 31.2
		var hc := c + off
		var pulse := 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(t * 3.0 - i * 0.9)
		var hx := _hex(hc, 17.0)
		draw_colored_polygon(hx, Color(vio.r, vio.g, vio.b, 0.08 + 0.4 * on * pulse))
		draw_polyline(_loop(hx), _col(vio, 0.45 + 0.9 * on * pulse), 2.0, true)
	for k in 6:
		var v := c + Vector2.from_angle(k * PI / 3.0) * hr
		if on > 0.05:
			_glow(v, 6.0, vio, on)
		_disc(v, 6.5, Color(0.12, 0.09, 0.2), _col(vio, 0.6 + 0.8 * on), 2.0)
		draw_circle(v, 2.5, _col(vio, 0.4 + 1.4 * on))
	for k in 12:
		var a := slow * 0.9 + k * TAU / 12.0
		draw_arc(c, 84.0, a, a + 0.32, 6, Color(vio.r, vio.g, vio.b, 0.3 + 0.6 * on), 3.0, true)
	var d := 11.0 + 2.0 * sin(t * 4.0) * on
	var diamond := PackedVector2Array([c + Vector2(0, -d * 1.4), c + Vector2(d, 0), c + Vector2(0, d * 1.4), c + Vector2(-d, 0)])
	draw_colored_polygon(diamond, _col(vio, 0.4 + 1.5 * on))
	draw_polyline(_loop(diamond), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.3 + 0.6 * on), 1.5, true)
	if on > 0.02:
		var br := 122.0 + 5.0 * sin(t * 2.0)
		draw_circle(c, br, Color(vio.r, vio.g, vio.b, 0.05 * on))
		draw_arc(c, br, 0.0, TAU, 72, Color(vio.r, vio.g, vio.b, 0.35 * on), 3.0, true)
		draw_arc(c, br - 8.0, 0.0, TAU, 72, Color(1.0, 0.8, 1.0, 0.12 * on), 1.5, true)

func _draw_comms() -> void:
	var r := rect
	var c := r.get_center()
	var on := power_k
	var pink := Color(1.0, 0.35, 0.7)
	_rbox(r, Color(0.14, 0.09, 0.13), Color(0.9, 0.3, 0.6), 10, 3)
	_rbox(r.grow(-8.0), Color(0.09, 0.06, 0.09), Color(0.3, 0.13, 0.25), 6, 1)
	var rack := Rect2(r.position + Vector2(14, 14), Vector2(52.0, r.size.y - 28.0))
	_rbox(rack, Color(0.06, 0.04, 0.07), Color(0.4, 0.2, 0.35), 4, 2)
	for i in 6:
		var ry := rack.position.y + 7.0 + i * ((rack.size.y - 14.0) / 6.0)
		_rbox(Rect2(rack.position.x + 5.0, ry, rack.size.x - 10.0, 10.0), Color(0.14, 0.1, 0.15), Color(0.3, 0.2, 0.3), 2, 1)
		_led(Vector2(rack.position.x + 13.0, ry + 5.0), pink if i % 2 == 0 else Color(0.4, 1.0, 0.6), on)
		var bar := (0.3 + 0.7 * absf(sin(t * 2.0 + i * 1.3))) * on
		draw_rect(Rect2(rack.position.x + 22.0, ry + 3.0, (rack.size.x - 32.0) * bar, 4.0), _col(pink, 0.8 + 0.6 * on))
	var dc := Vector2(r.end.x - 62.0, c.y)
	_disc(dc, 52.0, Color(0.13, 0.11, 0.14), Color(0.8, 0.8, 0.9), 3.0)
	for k in 4:
		draw_arc(dc, 44.0 - k * 10.0, 0.0, TAU, 40, Color(0.75, 0.75, 0.85, 0.2 + 0.08 * k), 2.0, true)
	for k in 10:
		var a := k * TAU / 10.0
		draw_line(dc + Vector2.from_angle(a) * 8.0, dc + Vector2.from_angle(a) * 50.0, Color(0.55, 0.55, 0.65, 0.55), 1.5)
	var aim := sin(slow * 1.1 + _phase) * 0.5
	var feed := dc + Vector2.from_angle(aim) * 34.0
	draw_line(dc, feed, Color(0.7, 0.7, 0.8), 4.0, true)
	_disc(dc, 8.0, Color(0.2, 0.2, 0.25), Color(0.8, 0.8, 0.9), 2.0)
	if on > 0.05:
		_glow(feed, 6.0, pink, on)
	_disc(feed, 6.0, Color(0.2, 0.1, 0.16), _col(pink, 0.6 + 0.9 * on), 2.0)
	if on > 0.05:
		for i in 3:
			var rr := fposmod(t * 34.0 + i * 14.0, 42.0)
			draw_arc(feed, rr + 8.0, aim - 0.7, aim + 0.7, 12, Color(pink.r, pink.g, pink.b, (1.0 - rr / 42.0) * 0.9 * on), 2.5, true)
	var blink := 1.0 if fmod(t, 1.2) < 0.2 else 0.15
	_led(Vector2(rack.end.x + 12.0, r.position.y + 18.0), Color(1.0, 0.25, 0.2), on * blink)

func _draw_state() -> void:
	var c := rect.get_center()
	var idle := 1.0 - power_k
	if idle > 0.02 and not host.is_broken:
		_rbox(rect, Color(0.01, 0.02, 0.04, 0.5 * idle), Color(0, 0, 0, 0), 8, 0)
		var blink := 0.55 + 0.45 * sin(t * 4.0)
		_bolt_icon(c, Color(1.0, 0.8, 0.2, idle * blink))
	if broken_k > 0.02:
		var fl := 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(t * 14.0)
		_rbox(rect, Color(1.0, 0.08, 0.05, 0.22 * broken_k * (0.4 + 0.6 * fl)), Color(1.0, 0.2, 0.15, broken_k * fl), 8, 3)
		_warn_icon(c, broken_k, fl)
		_sparks(broken_k)

func _bolt_icon(p: Vector2, col: Color) -> void:
	var pts := PackedVector2Array([Vector2(3, -22), Vector2(-9, 2), Vector2(-1, 2), Vector2(-4, 22), Vector2(10, -4), Vector2(2, -4)])
	for i in pts.size():
		pts[i] += p
	draw_colored_polygon(pts, col)
	draw_line(p + Vector2(-16, -20), p + Vector2(16, 20), Color(1.0, 0.2, 0.15, col.a), 3.5, true)

func _warn_icon(p: Vector2, k: float, fl: float) -> void:
	var s := 1.0 + 0.1 * fl
	var pts := PackedVector2Array([Vector2(0, -26) * s + p, Vector2(24, 18) * s + p, Vector2(-24, 18) * s + p])
	draw_colored_polygon(pts, Color(1.0, 0.15, 0.1, 0.85 * k))
	draw_polyline(_loop(pts), Color(1.0, 0.8, 0.7, k), 2.5, true)
	draw_line(p + Vector2(0, -9) * s, p + Vector2(0, 5) * s, Color(1, 1, 1, k), 4.0, true)
	draw_circle(p + Vector2(0, 12) * s, 2.8, Color(1, 1, 1, k))

func _sparks(k: float) -> void:
	rng.seed = int(t * 9.0) * 7919 + 13
	for i in 5:
		var p := rect.position + Vector2(rng.randf() * rect.size.x, rng.randf() * rect.size.y)
		var d := Vector2.from_angle(rng.randf() * TAU) * (6.0 + rng.randf() * 14.0)
		draw_line(p, p + d, Color(1.8, 1.4, 0.5, k), 2.0, true)
		draw_circle(p, 2.0, Color(2.0, 1.8, 1.0, k))

func _draw_scaffold() -> void:
	var r := rect
	var cut := r.size.y * (1.0 - build_k)
	if cut > 1.0:
		_rbox(Rect2(r.position, Vector2(r.size.x, cut)), Color(0.04, 0.16, 0.28, 0.82), Color(0.3, 0.8, 1.0, 0.8), 6, 1)
		var gx := r.position.x + 16.0
		while gx < r.end.x:
			draw_line(Vector2(gx, r.position.y), Vector2(gx, r.position.y + cut), Color(0.4, 0.9, 1.0, 0.18), 1.0)
			gx += 16.0
		var gy := r.position.y + 16.0
		while gy < r.position.y + cut:
			draw_line(Vector2(r.position.x, gy), Vector2(r.end.x, gy), Color(0.4, 0.9, 1.0, 0.18), 1.0)
			gy += 16.0
	var sy := r.position.y + cut
	draw_line(Vector2(r.position.x, sy), Vector2(r.end.x, sy), Color(0.5, 1.6, 2.0, 0.95), 3.0, true)
	_brackets(r.grow(6.0), Color(0.5, 1.4, 1.8, 0.6 + 0.4 * sin(t * 8.0)), 22.0, 3.0)

func _draw_blueprint() -> void:
	var r := rect
	var gx := r.position.x + 32.0
	while gx < r.end.x - 1.0:
		draw_line(Vector2(gx, r.position.y), Vector2(gx, r.end.y), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.14), 1.0)
		gx += 32.0
	var gy := r.position.y + 32.0
	while gy < r.end.y - 1.0:
		draw_line(Vector2(r.position.x, gy), Vector2(r.end.x, gy), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.14), 1.0)
		gy += 32.0
	draw_line(r.position, r.end, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.1), 1.0)
	draw_line(Vector2(r.end.x, r.position.y), Vector2(r.position.x, r.end.y), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.1), 1.0)
	draw_rect(r, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.55), false, 2.0)
	_brackets(r.grow(8.0), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.9), 26.0, 3.0)

================================================================================
FILE: scripts\polish\polish.gd
================================================================================

extends Node
## POLISH â€” drop-in visual layer for the Game scene (autoload).
## Adds: bloom, ambient lighting + shadows, module glow, dust/spark particles,
## CRT/vignette post FX, themed shop UI (cutscene font), survival HUD, alerts.
## It only READS existing game state. It never edits game scripts or the cutscene.

const GAME_SCENE := "game.tscn"
## Name of the Game-node property that holds your shop CanvasLayer. If it's missing/renamed,
## Polish falls back to auto-detecting any other CanvasLayer under the Game node.
const SHOP_PROPERTY := "shop_layer"
## Buttons whose text contains one of these words get the "primary" pulse.
## (Or tag any node yourself:  node.set_meta("polish_primary", true) )
## To exclude any node + its children from Polish:  node.set_meta("no_polish", true)
const PRIMARY_WORDS := ["CONFIRM", "DEPLOY", "LAUNCH", "START", "BEGIN", "PLAY"]
const GLOW := 1.12   # HDR multiplier for glowing things (1.0 = no bloom from them)
const FONT_NAMES := ["Courier New", "monospace"]   # same font as cutscene.gd

const C_BG      := Color(0.04, 0.06, 0.09, 0.96)
const C_PANEL   := Color(0.06, 0.09, 0.13, 0.92)
const C_EDGE    := Color(0.20, 0.75, 0.95, 0.85)
const C_GREEN   := Color(0.40, 1.00, 0.55)
const C_CYAN    := Color(0.30, 0.85, 1.00)
const C_AMBER   := Color(1.00, 0.85, 0.30)
const C_RED     := Color(1.00, 0.25, 0.20)

var font: SystemFont
var ui_theme: Theme
var soft_tex: GradientTexture2D
var ring_tex: GradientTexture2D

var _scene: Node = null
var _installed := false
var _game: Node2D
var _t := 0.0

# lighting
var _modulate: CanvasModulate
var _player_light: PointLight2D
var _reactor_light: PointLight2D
var _module_lights: Dictionary = {}   # module -> PointLight2D
var _dust: CPUParticles2D
var _sparks: CPUParticles2D

# shop
var _shop_seen: CanvasLayer = null
var _shop_labels: Dictionary = {}   # Label -> [last_text, base_modulate]
var _card_idx := 0
var _fx_layer: CanvasLayer
var _fx_dust: CPUParticles2D
var _fx_bokeh: CPUParticles2D
var _fx_embers: CPUParticles2D
var _fx_size := Vector2.ZERO

# hud
var _hud: CanvasLayer
var _bars: Dictionary = {}
var _alert_box: VBoxContainer
var _crit_label: Label
var _crit_flash: ColorRect
var _crit_time := 0.0

func _ready() -> void:
	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	font = SystemFont.new()
	font.font_names = PackedStringArray(FONT_NAMES)
	soft_tex = _radial_tex(256, 0.0)
	ring_tex = _radial_tex(64, 0.0)
	ui_theme = _build_theme()
	get_tree().node_added.connect(_on_node_added)

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	_t += delta
	var cs := get_tree().current_scene
	if cs != _scene:
		_scene = cs
		_installed = false
		_teardown()
		if cs != null and cs.scene_file_path.get_file() == GAME_SCENE:
			_install(cs)
	if not _installed:
		return
	_update_lighting(delta)
	_update_particles()
	_update_shop(delta)
	_update_hud(delta)

func _teardown() -> void:
	_module_lights.clear()
	_shop_labels.clear()
	_shop_seen = null
	_bars.clear()
	_crit_time = 0.0

# â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ install â”€â”€
func _install(game: Node) -> void:
	_game = game as Node2D
	_installed = true
	_setup_environment()
	_setup_lighting()
	_setup_particles()
	_setup_post_fx()
	_setup_hud()
	# connect signals once per install
	if not EventBus.module_broken.is_connected(_on_module_broken):
		EventBus.module_broken.connect(_on_module_broken)
	if not EventBus.game_over.is_connected(_on_game_over):
		EventBus.game_over.connect(_on_game_over)
	for n in _game.get_children():
		_style_existing(n)

func _style_existing(n: Node) -> void:
	if n is Line2D:
		_bloom_wire(n)

func _on_node_added(n: Node) -> void:
	if not _installed or not is_instance_valid(_game) or not _game.is_ancestor_of(n):
		return
	if n is Control and is_instance_valid(_shop_seen) and _shop_seen.is_ancestor_of(n):
		_decorate_control.call_deferred(n)
		return
	if n is ProgressBar:
		if not (n.get_parent() is Container):   # module repair/build bars only (HUD bars are themed already)
			(n as ProgressBar).theme = ui_theme
	elif n is Line2D:
		_bloom_wire.call_deferred(n)

func _bloom_wire(l: Line2D) -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(l):
		return
	# real wire (opaque colour) gets an HDR boost so bloom picks it up; shadow line is left alone
	if l.default_color.a > 0.9 and l.width >= 8.0:
		l.modulate = Color(GLOW, GLOW, GLOW, 1.0)

# â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ environment/bloom â”€â”€
func _setup_environment() -> void:
	get_viewport().use_hdr_2d = true
	var we := _game.get_node_or_null("WorldEnvironment") as WorldEnvironment
	if we == null:
		we = WorldEnvironment.new()
		we.name = "WorldEnvironment"
		_game.add_child(we)
	var env := we.environment
	if env == null:
		env = Environment.new()
		we.environment = env
	env.background_mode = Environment.BG_CANVAS      # required for 2D glow
	env.tonemap_mode = Environment.TONE_MAPPER_LINEAR   # keep your original colours
	env.glow_enabled = true
	env.glow_intensity = 0.45
	env.glow_strength = 0.9
	env.glow_bloom = 0.02
	env.glow_hdr_threshold = 1.15
	env.glow_hdr_scale = 0.9
	env.glow_blend_mode = Environment.GLOW_BLEND_MODE_SCREEN
	for i in range(7):
		env.set_glow_level(i, 1.0 if i in [1, 2, 4] else 0.55)
	env.adjustment_enabled = true
	env.adjustment_contrast = 1.08
	env.adjustment_saturation = 1.12

# â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ lighting â”€â”€
func _setup_lighting() -> void:
	_modulate = CanvasModulate.new()
	_modulate.name = "AmbientDark"
	_modulate.color = Color(0.36, 0.40, 0.52)
	_game.add_child(_modulate)

	# soft blob shadow under the player (fake contact shadow)
	var player := _game.get_node_or_null("Player") as Node2D
	if player != null:
		var blob := Sprite2D.new()
		blob.name = "BlobShadow"
		blob.texture = soft_tex
		blob.modulate = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.55)
		blob.scale = Vector2(0.28, 0.12)
		blob.position = Vector2(0, 30)
		blob.show_behind_parent = true
		player.add_child(blob)

		_player_light = _make_light(Color(0.75, 0.92, 1.0), 1.25, 3.2, true)
		_player_light.name = "PlayerTorch"
		_player_light.position = Vector2(0, -6)
		player.add_child(_player_light)

	var reactor := _game.get_node_or_null("Reactor") as Node2D
	if reactor != null:
		_reactor_light = _make_light(Color(0.2, 0.85, 1.0), 1.3, 4.2, false)
		_reactor_light.name = "ReactorGlow"
		_reactor_light.position = Vector2(64, 64)
		reactor.add_child(_reactor_light)
		_add_occluder_from_body(reactor)

	_build_wall_occluders_and_lamps()

func _make_light(col: Color, energy: float, scl: float, shadows: bool) -> PointLight2D:
	var l := PointLight2D.new()
	l.texture = soft_tex
	l.texture_scale = scl
	l.color = col
	l.energy = energy
	l.shadow_enabled = shadows
	if shadows:
		l.shadow_filter = Light2D.SHADOW_FILTER_PCF5
		l.shadow_filter_smooth = 2.0
		l.shadow_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.75)
	return l

func _add_occluder_from_body(body: Node2D) -> void:
	var cs := body.get_node_or_null("CollisionShape2D") as CollisionShape2D
	if cs == null or not (cs.shape is RectangleShape2D):
		return
	var sz := (cs.shape as RectangleShape2D).size
	var h := sz * 0.5
	var occ := LightOccluder2D.new()
	var poly := OccluderPolygon2D.new()
	poly.polygon = PackedVector2Array([
		cs.position + Vector2(-h.x, -h.y), cs.position + Vector2(h.x, -h.y),
		cs.position + Vector2(h.x, h.y), cs.position + Vector2(-h.x, h.y)])
	occ.occluder = poly
	body.add_child(occ)

func _build_wall_occluders_and_lamps() -> void:
	var tm := _game.get_node_or_null("spacestation") as TileMapLayer
	if tm == null or tm.tile_set == null:
		return
	var cells := tm.get_used_cells()
	var solid := {}
	var floor_cells: Array[Vector2i] = []
	for c in cells:
		var td := tm.get_cell_tile_data(c)
		if td != null and td.get_collision_polygons_count(0) > 0:
			solid[c] = true
		else:
			floor_cells.append(c)
	var half := Vector2(tm.tile_set.tile_size) * 0.5
	var made := 0
	for c in solid.keys():
		var edge := false
		for d in [Vector2i(1, 0), Vector2i(-1, 0), Vector2i(0, 1), Vector2i(0, -1)]:
			if not solid.has(c + d):
				edge = true
				break
		if not edge or made > 700:
			continue
		var occ := LightOccluder2D.new()
		var poly := OccluderPolygon2D.new()
		var p := tm.map_to_local(c)
		poly.polygon = PackedVector2Array([
			p + Vector2(-half.x, -half.y), p + Vector2(half.x, -half.y),
			p + Vector2(half.x, half.y), p + Vector2(-half.x, half.y)])
		occ.occluder = poly
		tm.add_child(occ)
		made += 1
	# ceiling lamps on a sparse grid over walkable floor
	var lamps := 0
	for c in floor_cells:
		if lamps >= 9:
			break
		if c.x % 7 == 0 and c.y % 6 == 0:
			var lamp := _make_light(Color(0.62, 0.80, 1.0), 0.85, 3.6, lamps < 5)
			lamp.position = tm.map_to_local(c)
			tm.add_child(lamp)
			lamps += 1

func _update_lighting(delta: float) -> void:
	# keep every module glowing in its own colour, reacting to power / broken state
	for m in BaseManager.active_modules:
		if not is_instance_valid(m):
			continue
		if not _module_lights.has(m):
			var vis := m.get_node_or_null("Visual") as ColorRect
			if vis == null:
				continue
			var l := _make_light(vis.color, 1.0, 2.2, false)
			l.position = vis.position + vis.size * 0.5
			m.add_child(l)
			_module_lights[m] = l
			_add_occluder_from_body(m)   # modules now cast shadows from lamps / torch
		var light: PointLight2D = _module_lights[m]
		var vis2 := m.get_node_or_null("Visual") as ColorRect
		if vis2 == null:
			continue
		if m.is_broken:
			var pulse := 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(_t * 10.0)
			light.color = Color(1.0, 0.15, 0.1)
			light.energy = 0.5 + 1.0 * pulse
			vis2.modulate = Color(1.0 + 0.3 * pulse, 1.0, 1.0)
		elif m.is_powered or m.module_name == "Reactor":
			light.color = m.base_visual_color
			light.energy = lerpf(light.energy, 1.3 + 0.12 * sin(_t * 3.0), delta * 6.0)
			vis2.modulate = Color(GLOW, GLOW, GLOW)
		else:
			light.energy = lerpf(light.energy, 0.12, delta * 4.0)
			vis2.modulate = Color(1, 1, 1)
	if _reactor_light != null and is_instance_valid(_reactor_light):
		var e := clampf(BaseManager.reactor_energy / 100.0, 0.0, 1.0)
		_reactor_light.energy = (0.4 + 1.1 * e) * (0.94 + 0.06 * sin(_t * 5.0))
	if _player_light != null:
		_player_light.energy = 1.15 + 0.06 * sin(_t * 2.3)
	# critical ambient: tint the whole base red when a system is nearly dead
	var danger := _danger_level()
	var target := Color(0.36, 0.40, 0.52).lerp(Color(0.46, 0.22, 0.24), danger)
	_modulate.color = _modulate.color.lerp(target, delta * 3.0)

func _danger_level() -> float:
	var worst := minf(BaseManager.oxygen_level, BaseManager.temp_level)
	return clampf(1.0 - worst / 30.0, 0.0, 1.0) if GameManager.current_phase == GameManager.Phase.SURVIVE else 0.0

# â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ particles â”€â”€
## Ambient particles live on their own CanvasLayer (screen space), so the dark
## ambient tint can't swallow them and they always read clearly.
func _emitter(amount: int, life: float, add_mat: Material) -> CPUParticles2D:
	var p := CPUParticles2D.new()
	p.texture = ring_tex
	p.material = add_mat
	p.amount = amount
	p.lifetime = life
	p.preprocess = life
	p.emission_shape = CPUParticles2D.EMISSION_SHAPE_RECTANGLE
	p.emission_rect_extents = Vector2(960, 540)
	p.gravity = Vector2.ZERO
	var g := Gradient.new()
	g.set_color(0, Color(1, 1, 1, 0))
	g.set_color(1, Color(1, 1, 1, 0))
	g.add_point(0.25, Color(1, 1, 1, 1))
	g.add_point(0.75, Color(1, 1, 1, 1))
	p.color_ramp = g
	return p

func _setup_particles() -> void:
	var add_mat := CanvasItemMaterial.new()
	add_mat.blend_mode = CanvasItemMaterial.BLEND_MODE_ADD
	_fx_layer = CanvasLayer.new()
	_fx_layer.name = "AmbientFX"
	_fx_layer.layer = 11          # above the shop, below HUD (20) and post-fx (50)
	_game.add_child(_fx_layer)

	# 1) dust motes: lots of small bright specks drifting across the screen
	_fx_dust = _emitter(160, 11.0, add_mat)
	_fx_dust.direction = Vector2(1, -0.3)
	_fx_dust.spread = 70.0
	_fx_dust.initial_velocity_min = 8.0
	_fx_dust.initial_velocity_max = 30.0
	_fx_dust.scale_amount_min = 0.05
	_fx_dust.scale_amount_max = 0.16
	_fx_dust.color = Color(0.65, 0.9, 1.0, 0.75)
	_fx_layer.add_child(_fx_dust)

	# 2) bokeh: a few huge, very faint soft orbs for depth
	_fx_bokeh = _emitter(14, 16.0, add_mat)
	_fx_bokeh.direction = Vector2(-1, 0.15)
	_fx_bokeh.spread = 40.0
	_fx_bokeh.initial_velocity_min = 5.0
	_fx_bokeh.initial_velocity_max = 14.0
	_fx_bokeh.scale_amount_min = 0.9
	_fx_bokeh.scale_amount_max = 2.0
	_fx_bokeh.color = Color(0.35, 0.7, 1.0, 0.09)
	_fx_layer.add_child(_fx_bokeh)

	# 3) warm embers floating upward
	_fx_embers = _emitter(36, 7.0, add_mat)
	_fx_embers.direction = Vector2(0, -1)
	_fx_embers.spread = 25.0
	_fx_embers.initial_velocity_min = 18.0
	_fx_embers.initial_velocity_max = 55.0
	_fx_embers.gravity = Vector2(6, -6)
	_fx_embers.scale_amount_min = 0.05
	_fx_embers.scale_amount_max = 0.12
	_fx_embers.color = Color(1.0, 0.7, 0.35, 0.85)
	_fx_layer.add_child(_fx_embers)

	# 4) reactor sparks live in the world (they should stay on the reactor)
	var reactor := _game.get_node_or_null("Reactor") as Node2D
	if reactor != null:
		_sparks = _emitter(40, 2.4, add_mat)
		_sparks.name = "ReactorSparks"
		_sparks.local_coords = false
		_sparks.position = Vector2(64, 64)
		_sparks.emission_shape = CPUParticles2D.EMISSION_SHAPE_SPHERE
		_sparks.emission_sphere_radius = 60.0
		_sparks.direction = Vector2(0, -1)
		_sparks.spread = 180.0
		_sparks.initial_velocity_min = 16.0
		_sparks.initial_velocity_max = 60.0
		_sparks.scale_amount_min = 0.05
		_sparks.scale_amount_max = 0.12
		_sparks.color = Color(1.2, 3.0, 3.6, 1.0)   # bright enough to survive the ambient tint
		_sparks.z_index = 60
		reactor.add_child(_sparks)

func _update_particles() -> void:
	if _fx_dust != null:
		var vs := get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
		if vs != _fx_size:
			_fx_size = vs
			for p in [_fx_dust, _fx_bokeh, _fx_embers]:
				p.position = vs * 0.5
				p.emission_rect_extents = vs * 0.5 + Vector2(40, 40)
	if _sparks != null and is_instance_valid(_sparks):
		_sparks.emitting = BaseManager.reactor_energy > 0.0

# â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ post-process â”€â”€
const POST_SHADER := """
shader_type canvas_item;
uniform sampler2D screen_tex : hint_screen_texture, filter_linear_mipmap;
uniform float vignette = 0.55;
uniform float aberration = 1.4;
uniform float scan = 0.035;
uniform float grain = 0.035;
uniform float danger = 0.0;
float hash(vec2 p){ return fract(sin(dot(p, vec2(12.9898,78.233))) * 43758.5453); }
void fragment(){
	vec2 uv = SCREEN_UV;
	vec2 c = uv - 0.5;
	float d = dot(c, c);
	vec2 off = c * d * aberration * 0.012;
	vec3 col;
	col.r = texture(screen_tex, uv + off).r;
	col.g = texture(screen_tex, uv).g;
	col.b = texture(screen_tex, uv - off).b;
	float line = sin(uv.y * 900.0) * 0.5 + 0.5;
	col *= 1.0 - scan * line;
	col += (hash(uv * 900.0 + fract(TIME)) - 0.5) * grain;
	float v = smoothstep(0.15, 0.85, d * 2.2);
	col *= 1.0 - v * vignette;
	col = mix(col, col * vec3(1.4, 0.55, 0.55), danger * v * 1.5);
	COLOR = vec4(col, 1.0);
}
"""
var _post_mat: ShaderMaterial

func _setup_post_fx() -> void:
	var layer := CanvasLayer.new()
	layer.name = "PostFX"
	layer.layer = 50
	_game.add_child(layer)
	var rect := ColorRect.new()
	rect.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	rect.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	var sh := Shader.new()
	sh.code = POST_SHADER
	_post_mat = ShaderMaterial.new()
	_post_mat.shader = sh
	rect.material = _post_mat
	layer.add_child(rect)

# â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ theme â”€â”€
func _build_theme() -> Theme:
	var t := Theme.new()
	t.default_font = font
	t.default_font_size = 18

	t.set_color("font_color", "Label", Color(0.85, 0.92, 0.95))
	t.set_color("font_shadow_color", "Label", Color(0, 0, 0, 0.6))
	t.set_constant("shadow_offset_x", "Label", 1)
	t.set_constant("shadow_offset_y", "Label", 2)

	t.set_stylebox("panel", "PanelContainer", _box(C_PANEL, C_EDGE * Color(1, 1, 1, 0.45), 1, 6, 14))
	t.set_stylebox("normal", "Button", _box(Color(0.07, 0.15, 0.2, 0.95), C_EDGE * Color(1, 1, 1, 0.6), 1, 4, 6))
	t.set_stylebox("hover", "Button", _box(Color(0.10, 0.26, 0.34, 1.0), C_CYAN, 2, 4, 12))
	t.set_stylebox("pressed", "Button", _box(Color(0.30, 0.80, 0.95, 1.0), Color.WHITE, 2, 4, 4))
	t.set_stylebox("disabled", "Button", _box(Color(0.08, 0.1, 0.12, 0.7), Color(0.3, 0.3, 0.35, 0.4), 1, 4, 0))
	t.set_stylebox("focus", "Button", _box(Color(0, 0, 0, 0), C_GREEN, 2, 4, 0))
	t.set_color("font_color", "Button", Color(0.75, 0.95, 1.0))
	t.set_color("font_hover_color", "Button", Color(1.0, 1.0, 1.0))
	t.set_color("font_pressed_color", "Button", Color(0.02, 0.1, 0.14))
	t.set_color("font_disabled_color", "Button", Color(0.4, 0.45, 0.5))

	t.set_stylebox("background", "ProgressBar", _box(Color(0.02, 0.03, 0.04, 0.85), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.25), 1, 3, 0))
	t.set_stylebox("fill", "ProgressBar", _box(Color(1, 1, 1, 0.95), Color(0, 0, 0, 0), 0, 3, 0))

	var sep := StyleBoxLine.new()
	sep.color = C_EDGE * Color(1, 1, 1, 0.5)
	sep.thickness = 1
	t.set_stylebox("separator", "HSeparator", sep)
	return t

func _box(bg: Color, border: Color, bw: int, radius: int, glow: int) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var s := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	s.bg_color = bg
	s.border_color = border
	s.set_border_width_all(bw)
	s.set_corner_radius_all(radius)
	s.shadow_color = Color(border.r, border.g, border.b, 0.28 if glow > 0 else 0.0)
	s.shadow_size = glow
	s.content_margin_left = 10
	s.content_margin_right = 10
	s.content_margin_top = 6
	s.content_margin_bottom = 6
	return s

func _radial_tex(sz: int, _unused: float) -> GradientTexture2D:
	var g := Gradient.new()
	g.set_color(0, Color(1, 1, 1, 1))
	g.set_color(1, Color(1, 1, 1, 0))
	g.add_point(0.35, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.55))
	var tex := GradientTexture2D.new()
	tex.gradient = g
	tex.fill = GradientTexture2D.FILL_RADIAL
	tex.fill_from = Vector2(0.5, 0.5)
	tex.fill_to = Vector2(1.0, 0.5)
	tex.width = sz
	tex.height = sz
	return tex

# â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ shop UI â”€â”€
class Brackets extends Control:
	var col := Color(0.3, 0.85, 1.0, 0.9)
	var arm := 16.0
	var phase := 0.0
	func _ready() -> void:
		mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
		set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	func _process(delta: float) -> void:
		phase += delta
		queue_redraw()
	func _draw() -> void:
		var a := arm + 2.0 * sin(phase * 2.0)
		var c := col
		var s := size
		var w := 2.0
		draw_line(Vector2(0, 0), Vector2(a, 0), c, w)
		draw_line(Vector2(0, 0), Vector2(0, a), c, w)
		draw_line(Vector2(s.x, 0), Vector2(s.x - a, 0), c, w)
		draw_line(Vector2(s.x, 0), Vector2(s.x, a), c, w)
		draw_line(Vector2(0, s.y), Vector2(a, s.y), c, w)
		draw_line(Vector2(0, s.y), Vector2(0, s.y - a), c, w)
		draw_line(Vector2(s.x, s.y), Vector2(s.x - a, s.y), c, w)
		draw_line(Vector2(s.x, s.y), Vector2(s.x, s.y - a), c, w)

const GRID_SHADER := """
shader_type canvas_item;
uniform vec4 base : source_color = vec4(0.04, 0.06, 0.09, 0.96);
void fragment(){
	vec2 p = FRAGCOORD.xy;
	float g1 = step(0.97, fract(p.x / 48.0)) + step(0.97, fract(p.y / 48.0));
	float g2 = step(0.995, fract(p.x / 192.0)) + step(0.995, fract(p.y / 192.0));
	float sweep = smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, 1.0 - abs(fract(TIME * 0.08 - UV.y) - 0.5) * 12.0);
	vec3 col = base.rgb + vec3(0.0, 0.10, 0.14) * (g1 * 0.25 + g2 * 0.5);
	col += vec3(0.0, 0.25, 0.3) * max(sweep, 0.0) * 0.06;
	float v = distance(UV, vec2(0.5));
	col *= 1.0 - v * 0.7;
	COLOR = vec4(col, base.a);
}
"""

func _find_shop() -> CanvasLayer:
	var v = _game.get(SHOP_PROPERTY)
	if v is CanvasLayer and is_instance_valid(v) and not v.is_queued_for_deletion():
		return v
	if v != null:
		return null
	# fallback: any CanvasLayer under Game that isn't one of ours
	for ch in _game.get_children():
		if ch is CanvasLayer and ch != _hud and ch != _fx_layer and ch.name != "PostFX" \
				and not ch.has_meta("no_polish") and not ch.is_queued_for_deletion() and ch.get_child_count() > 0:
			return ch
	return null

func _update_shop(_delta: float) -> void:
	var shop := _find_shop()
	if shop != _shop_seen:
		_shop_seen = shop
		_shop_labels.clear()
		if shop != null:
			_decorate_shop(shop)
	if shop == null:
		return
	# generic "value changed" juice for EVERY label in the shop
	for l in _shop_labels.keys():
		if not is_instance_valid(l):
			_shop_labels.erase(l)
			continue
		var info: Array = _shop_labels[l]
		if l.text != info[0]:
			info[0] = l.text
			_label_pop(l, info[1])

func _label_pop(l: Label, base: Color) -> void:
	if l.size.x < 500.0:
		l.pivot_offset = l.size * 0.5
		l.scale = Vector2(1.18, 1.18)
		create_tween().set_trans(Tween.TRANS_BACK).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT).tween_property(l, "scale", Vector2.ONE, 0.25)
	l.modulate = Color(1.5, 1.5, 1.3)
	create_tween().tween_property(l, "modulate", base, 0.4)

func _is_skipped(n: Node) -> bool:
	var p := n
	while p != null and p != _shop_seen:
		if p.has_meta("no_polish"):
			return true
		p = p.get_parent()
	return false

func _decorate_shop(shop: CanvasLayer) -> void:
	_card_idx = 0
	var bg_done := false
	for k in shop.get_children():
		if not (k is Control) or k.has_meta("no_polish"):
			continue
		var c := k as Control
		var full := c.anchor_right >= 0.99 and c.anchor_bottom >= 0.99
		if c is ColorRect and full and not bg_done and c.material == null:
			bg_done = true
			var sh := Shader.new()
			sh.code = GRID_SHADER
			var sm := ShaderMaterial.new()
			sm.shader = sh
			c.material = sm
			continue
		if c.theme == null:
			c.theme = ui_theme
		c.modulate.a = 0.0
		create_tween().tween_property(c, "modulate:a", 1.0, 0.5)
	_walk_decorate(shop)
	# title = biggest label in the shop: soft glow + type-on
	var title: Label = null
	var best := 0
	for l in _shop_labels.keys():
		var fs: int = (l as Label).get_theme_font_size("font_size")
		if fs > best:
			best = fs
			title = l
	if title != null and best >= 26:
		title.modulate = Color(GLOW, GLOW, GLOW)
		_shop_labels[title][1] = title.modulate
		title.add_theme_color_override("font_shadow_color", Color(0.2, 1.0, 0.4, 0.35))
		title.add_theme_constant_override("shadow_offset_x", 0)
		title.add_theme_constant_override("shadow_offset_y", 0)
		title.visible_ratio = 0.0
		create_tween().tween_property(title, "visible_ratio", 1.0, 1.0)
	# status light in the corner (independent of layout)
	var status := Label.new()
	status.text = "â— LINK ESTABLISHED"
	status.theme = ui_theme
	status.set_meta("polished", true)
	status.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_TOP_RIGHT)
	status.grow_horizontal = Control.GROW_DIRECTION_BEGIN
	status.position += Vector2(-24, 12)
	status.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	status.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 13)
	status.add_theme_color_override("font_color", C_GREEN)
	shop.add_child(status)
	var blink := status.create_tween().set_loops()
	blink.tween_property(status, "modulate:a", 0.25, 0.7)
	blink.tween_property(status, "modulate:a", 1.0, 0.7)

func _walk_decorate(n: Node) -> void:
	for c in n.get_children():
		if c is Control:
			_decorate_control(c)
		_walk_decorate(c)

## Decorates ONE control purely by its type â€” no assumptions about layout.
func _decorate_control(c: Node) -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(c) or not (c is Control) or c.has_meta("polished") or _is_skipped(c):
		return
	c.set_meta("polished", true)
	if c is Brackets:
		return
	if c is Button:
		_juice_button(c)
	elif c is PanelContainer:
		_decorate_card(c)
	elif c is Label:
		_shop_labels[c] = [(c as Label).text, (c as Label).modulate]

func _decorate_card(card: PanelContainer) -> void:
	var br := Brackets.new()
	br.set_meta("polished", true)
	card.add_child(br)
	if not card.has_theme_stylebox_override("panel"):   # respect your own panel style if you set one
		var normal := _box(C_PANEL, C_EDGE * Color(1, 1, 1, 0.45), 1, 6, 14)
		var hot := _box(Color(0.07, 0.12, 0.18, 0.97), C_CYAN, 2, 6, 26)
		card.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", normal)
		card.mouse_entered.connect(func():
			card.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", hot)
			br.arm = 26.0)
		card.mouse_exited.connect(func():
			card.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", normal)
			br.arm = 16.0)
	var delay := minf(0.2 + _card_idx * 0.12, 1.0)
	_card_idx += 1
	card.modulate.a = 0.0
	create_tween().tween_property(card, "modulate:a", 1.0, 0.5).set_delay(delay)

func _juice_button(b: Button) -> void:
	b.mouse_default_cursor_shape = Control.CURSOR_POINTING_HAND
	b.resized.connect(func(): b.pivot_offset = b.size * 0.5)
	b.mouse_entered.connect(func():
		b.pivot_offset = b.size * 0.5
		create_tween().set_trans(Tween.TRANS_BACK).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT).tween_property(b, "scale", Vector2(1.06, 1.06), 0.15)
		b.modulate = Color(GLOW, GLOW, GLOW))
	b.mouse_exited.connect(func():
		create_tween().tween_property(b, "scale", Vector2.ONE, 0.12)
		b.modulate = Color.WHITE)
	b.button_down.connect(func():
		b.pivot_offset = b.size * 0.5
		b.scale = Vector2(0.94, 0.94))
	b.button_up.connect(func():
		create_tween().set_trans(Tween.TRANS_BACK).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT).tween_property(b, "scale", Vector2(1.06, 1.06), 0.18))
	var up := b.text.to_upper()
	var primary := b.has_meta("polish_primary")
	for w in PRIMARY_WORDS:
		if up.contains(w):
			primary = true
	if primary:
		var tw := b.create_tween().set_loops()
		tw.tween_property(b, "self_modulate", Color(GLOW, GLOW, GLOW), 0.9)
		tw.tween_property(b, "self_modulate", Color.WHITE, 0.9)

# â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ HUD â”€â”€
func _setup_hud() -> void:
	_hud = CanvasLayer.new()
	_hud.name = "SurvivalHUD"
	_hud.layer = 20
	_game.add_child(_hud)

	_crit_flash = ColorRect.new()
	_crit_flash.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	_crit_flash.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	_crit_flash.color = Color(1, 0.05, 0.05, 0.0)
	_hud.add_child(_crit_flash)

	var root := MarginContainer.new()
	root.theme = ui_theme
	root.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	root.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	for s in ["left", "top", "right", "bottom"]:
		root.add_theme_constant_override("margin_" + s, 24)
	_hud.add_child(root)

	var panel := PanelContainer.new()
	panel.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_BEGIN
	panel.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_BEGIN
	panel.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	root.add_child(panel)
	panel.add_child(Brackets.new())
	var vb := VBoxContainer.new()
	vb.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
	panel.add_child(vb)
	var head := Label.new()
	head.text = "// HABITAT STATUS"
	head.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 14)
	head.add_theme_color_override("font_color", C_GREEN)
	head.modulate = Color(GLOW, GLOW, GLOW)
	vb.add_child(head)
	vb.add_child(HSeparator.new())
	_add_bar(vb, "O2   ", "o2", C_CYAN)
	_add_bar(vb, "TEMP ", "temp", Color(1.0, 0.55, 0.25))
	_add_bar(vb, "CORE ", "core", C_GREEN)
	_add_bar(vb, "LOAD ", "load", C_AMBER)
	_hud_panel = panel

	_alert_box = VBoxContainer.new()
	_alert_box.theme = ui_theme
	_alert_box.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_CENTER_TOP)
	_alert_box.position.y = 28
	_alert_box.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	_alert_box.grow_horizontal = Control.GROW_DIRECTION_BOTH
	_alert_box.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_BEGIN
	_hud.add_child(_alert_box)

	_crit_label = Label.new()
	_crit_label.theme = ui_theme
	_crit_label.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_CENTER)
	_crit_label.grow_horizontal = Control.GROW_DIRECTION_BOTH
	_crit_label.grow_vertical = Control.GROW_DIRECTION_BOTH
	_crit_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 40)
	_crit_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", C_RED)
	_crit_label.modulate = Color(1.3, 0.7, 0.6, 0.0)
	_crit_label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	_hud.add_child(_crit_label)
	_hud_panel.modulate.a = 0.0

var _hud_panel: PanelContainer

func _add_bar(parent: Node, text: String, key: String, col: Color) -> void:
	var row := HBoxContainer.new()
	row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)
	parent.add_child(row)
	var l := Label.new()
	l.text = text
	l.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 16)
	l.add_theme_color_override("font_color", col)
	row.add_child(l)
	var pb := ProgressBar.new()
	pb.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(190, 16)
	pb.max_value = 100.0
	pb.show_percentage = false
	pb.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
	pb.modulate = col * Color(GLOW, GLOW, GLOW, 1.0)
	row.add_child(pb)
	var v := Label.new()
	v.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(52, 0)
	v.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT
	v.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 16)
	row.add_child(v)
	_bars[key] = {"bar": pb, "val": v, "col": col}

func _update_hud(delta: float) -> void:
	if _hud == null or not is_instance_valid(_hud):
		return
	var live := GameManager.current_phase == GameManager.Phase.SURVIVE
	_hud_panel.modulate.a = lerpf(_hud_panel.modulate.a, 1.0 if live else 0.0, delta * 4.0)
	if not live:
		return
	var vals := {
		"o2": BaseManager.oxygen_level,
		"temp": BaseManager.temp_level,
		"core": BaseManager.reactor_energy,
		"load": clampf(BaseManager.current_power_draw / maxf(BaseManager.total_power, 1.0) * 100.0, 0.0, 100.0)}
	for k in vals.keys():
		var d: Dictionary = _bars[k]
		var pb: ProgressBar = d["bar"]
		pb.value = lerpf(pb.value, vals[k], delta * 8.0)
		(d["val"] as Label).text = "%d%%" % int(vals[k])
		var low: bool = vals[k] < 25.0 and k != "load"
		var base: Color = d["col"]
		if low:
			var p := 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(_t * 9.0)
			pb.modulate = base.lerp(C_RED, 0.7) * Color(1.0 + 0.3 * p, 1.0 + 0.3 * p, 1.0 + 0.3 * p, 1.0)
			(d["val"] as Label).add_theme_color_override("font_color", C_RED)
		else:
			pb.modulate = base * Color(GLOW, GLOW, GLOW, 1.0)
			(d["val"] as Label).add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.85, 0.92, 0.95))
	# danger overlay + post-fx
	var danger := _danger_level()
	if _post_mat != null:
		_post_mat.set_shader_parameter("danger", danger * (0.7 + 0.3 * sin(_t * 6.0)))
	_crit_flash.color.a = danger * 0.10 * (0.5 + 0.5 * sin(_t * 6.0))
	_crit_time = maxf(0.0, _crit_time - delta)
	_crit_label.modulate.a = clampf(_crit_time, 0.0, 1.0) * (0.6 + 0.4 * sin(_t * 12.0))

func _on_module_broken(module_name: String) -> void:
	if not _installed or _alert_box == null:
		return
	_toast("âš   %s OFFLINE â€” HOLD [E] NEARBY TO REPAIR" % module_name.to_upper(), C_AMBER)
	var cam := get_viewport().get_camera_2d()
	if cam != null:
		var tw := create_tween()
		for i in 8:
			tw.tween_property(cam, "offset", Vector2(randf_range(-8, 8), randf_range(-8, 8)) * (1.0 - i / 8.0), 0.04)
		tw.tween_property(cam, "offset", Vector2.ZERO, 0.05)

func _on_game_over(reason: String) -> void:
	if not _installed or _crit_label == null:
		return
	_crit_label.text = "CRITICAL â€” " + reason
	_crit_time = 2.0   # re-armed every frame the condition persists

func _toast(msg: String, col: Color) -> void:
	var p := PanelContainer.new()
	p.theme = ui_theme
	p.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", _box(Color(0.12, 0.08, 0.04, 0.92), col, 2, 5, 22))
	p.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	var l := Label.new()
	l.text = msg
	l.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 18)
	l.add_theme_color_override("font_color", col)
	l.modulate = Color(GLOW, GLOW, GLOW)
	p.add_child(l)
	_alert_box.add_child(p)
	p.modulate.a = 0.0
	var tw := p.create_tween()
	tw.tween_property(p, "modulate:a", 1.0, 0.18)
	tw.tween_interval(3.2)
	tw.tween_property(p, "modulate:a", 0.0, 0.5)
	tw.tween_callback(p.queue_free)
